t: v. 老化（age的过去式）；成熟；变老
adj. 年老的；…岁的；老年人特有的
words.s: She is aged seventeen.
words.sz: 她十七岁了。

t: 无论如何， 至少； 不论以何种方式， 无论从什么角度
words.s: We're all going to die anyway.
words.sz: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。

t: 照料，看管；出席，参加；伴随（某人/某物）
words.s: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
words.sz: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。
words.d: To attend something is to go to it.

words.s: I won't abandon you.
words.sz: 我不会放弃你的。
words.d: To abandon something is to leave it forever or for a long time.

t: 代理，中介；代理处，经销处
words.s: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
words.sz: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。
words.d: An agency is a business or service set up to act for others.

words.s: Did you go anywhere during the summer vacation?
words.sz: 这个暑假你有去哪儿玩吗?

words.s: A growing child who doesn't seem to have much energy perhaps needs medical attention.
words.sz: 一个成长中的孩子如果没有充足的能量，可能需要药物治疗。
words.d: Attention is the notice, thought, or consideration of someone.

words.s: I'm not satisfied with my English ability.
words.sz: 我不滿意我的英語能力。
words.d: Ability is the quality of a person being able to do something well.

t: 议程；日常工作事项；日程表
words.s: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
words.sz: 讓我們繼續進行議程上的項目。
words.d: An agenda is a plan or goal that guides someone’s behavior.

t: 分离，分开；单独地，个别地；分离的；意见不一致的
words.s: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.
words.sz: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。
words.d: When people or things are apart, they are not next to each other.

words.s: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
words.sz: 抱著失敗主義的態度你無法打一場漂亮的仗。
words.d: Someone’s attitude is the way they feel and think.

t: 有能力的，能干的，显示出才华的
words.s: Tom said he thought that he'd be able to help Mary weed the garden today.
words.sz: 汤姆说他以为他今天能够帮玛丽的花园除草

t: 代理人，代理商；药剂；特工
words.s: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
words.sz: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

words.s: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
words.sz: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
words.d: An apartment is a set of rooms in a building where people live.

words.s: The magnet attracted the metal.
words.d: To attract means to make a person or thing come closer or be interested.

t: 在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的
大致；粗枝大叶；不拘小节的人
words.s: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
words.sz: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

t: 好斗的，侵略的；积极进取的，活跃有为的
words.s: He is an aggressive person.
words.sz: 他是个咄咄逼人的的人。
words.d: If someone is aggressive, then they constantly want to fight or argue.

words.s: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
words.sz: 珊瑚礁是这个地区的主要景点。

t: 到国外，在国外；广为流传
words.s: His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.
words.sz: 他的收入很高，所以每年都能出國旅行。
words.d: An action done abroad is done in a different country.

t: 同意，赞成；承认；约定，商定
words.s: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
words.sz: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。
words.d: To agree is to have the same opinion or belief as another person.

t: 显然的，明明白白的；表面上的，貌似（真实）的
words.s: Her happiness was apparent from the smile on her face.
words.d: Apparent means clear or easy to see.

t: 观众；听众；读者；接见；正式会见；拜会
words.s: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
words.sz: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。
words.d: An audience is a group of people who gather to watch someone do something.

t: 纯粹的，完全的；无疑的，肯定的
words.s: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
words.sz: 電腦現在是一個絕對必要的東西了。

words.s: I'm in absolutely total agreement.
words.sz: 我完全同意。
words.d: An agreement is a formal decision about future action.

words.s: Apparently, there is nothing that cannot happen today.
words.sz: 显然，今天什么事都有可能发生。

words.s: There is no school during August.
words.sz: 8月份没课。
words.d: August is the eighth month of the year.

words.s: I think I understood everything Tom said, but I'm not absolutely sure.
words.sz: 我认为我听懂了汤姆说的所有话，但我不确定。

t: (Ah)人名；(中)亚(广东话·威妥玛)；(缅)阿
有感染力，有吸引力；诉诸，求助；上诉，申诉
words.s: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
words.sz: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。
words.d: To appeal to someone is to be interesting or attractive.

words.s: I have a special relationship with my aunt.
words.sz: 我和我阿姨有種特別的情誼。

words.s: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
words.sz: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。
words.d: When something is academic, it relates to schools and education.

t: 向前地；领先地；在（某人或某事物的）前面；预先；在将来，为未来
words.s: If you can't come, you should let me know ahead of time.
words.sz: 如果你不能來，你該讓我提前知道。
words.d: If something is ahead of something else, it is in front of it.

t: 出现，暴露；出场；问世；来到；好像是，彷佛
words.s: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
words.sz: 国王明晚会亲自出现。
words.d: To appear is to seem.

t: 作者，创始人；写作，撰写，编写
words.s: This is the room where the author killed himself.
words.sz: 这就是那个作家自杀的房间。
words.d: An author is a person who wrote a certain piece of writing.

words.s: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.
words.sz: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。
words.d: To accept something that is offered is to take it.

t: 出现，出场；外表。外观，外貌
words.s: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
words.sz: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

t: 权力，威信，权威；权威者；有权威的典籍；当局，官方
words.s: He gave me authority to fire them.
words.sz: 他授權給我解僱了他們。
words.d: An authority is someone who has the power to make decisions and enforce rules and laws.

t: adj. 可接受的；合意的；可忍受的
目标，目的；目的在于；瞄准，针对
words.s: My aim is to become a helicopter pilot.
words.d: An aim is a goal someone wants to make happen.

t: 苹果，苹果树，苹果似的东西；[美俚]炸弹，手榴弹，（棒球的）球；[美俚]人，家伙。
words.s: If it looks like an apple and it tastes like an apple, it's probably an apple.
words.sz: 如果看起来像个苹果而且吃起来也像苹果的话，可能就是苹果。

t: 秋天；成熟期；渐衰期，凋落期
words.s: These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.
words.sz: 这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。
words.d: Autumn is the season of the year between summer and winter.

t: 接近，进入；享用机会；入口，通道
words.s: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.
words.sz: 我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。
words.d: Access is the right to enter or use something.

t: 空气，大气；天空；样子；曲调
words.s: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
words.sz: 因為空氣汙染的問題，也許有一天自行車會取代汽車。

words.s: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
words.sz: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。

t: 有效的，可利用的；（指人）可会见的，可与之交谈的等
words.s: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
words.sz: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。
words.d: If something is available, it means you can get it.

t: 事故；意外；[法] 意外事件；机遇
words.s: If he had been a little more careful, the accident would have been avoided.
words.sz: 如果他当时再小心一点点，事故就不会发生了。
words.d: An accident is unexpected, and may cause some trouble.

words.s: At the museum in the airport, you can see a lot of old aircraft.
words.d: An aircraft is a vehicle that flies in the sky, such as an airplane or helicopter.

t: 涂，敷；应用，使用；申请，请求
words.s: What Tom said doesn't apply in this situation.
words.sz: 汤姆所言不符时局。
words.d: To apply something means to put it on.

words.s: The average height of girls in this class is over 155 centimeters.
words.sz: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。
words.d: If something is average, it is at a normal level.

words.s: The airline has excellent customer service.
words.d: An airline is a company that takes people to different places by plane.

t: 约会；预约，约定；任命，委托；职务，职位
words.s: Make another appointment at the front desk.
words.sz: 在服務台另外預約。

words.s: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.
words.sz: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。
words.d: To avoid something is to stay away from it.

words.s: She will accompany me on the piano.
words.sz: 她會彈鋼琴為我伴奏。
words.d: To accompany other people means to join them or go with them.

words.s: In a few minutes we'll be landing at New Tokyo International Airport.
words.sz: 我们将于几分钟内降落在新东京国际机场。

t: 欣赏，赏识，重视；意识到，理解，领会
words.s: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
words.sz: 感謝你幫我解釋明白。
words.d: To appreciate something is to understand its good qualities.

words.s: He got an award for having the best grades in class.
words.d: An award is a prize for doing something well.

t: 相等的， 一致的， 依…而定的
words.s: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.
words.sz: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。

t: 惊恐，忧虑；警报，警钟，报警器；使惊恐
words.s: It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
words.sz: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。
words.d: An alarm is something that warns people of danger.

t: 靠近，接近；找...商量，同...联系；着手处理，开始对付
words.s: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.
words.sz: 真正的科学家不会这样去思考。
words.d: To approach something means to move close to it.

words.s: It's hard to believe that Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
words.sz: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。
words.d: If someone is aware, they know that something or a situation exists.

words.s: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
words.sz: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。
words.d: An account with a bank is an arrangement to keep one’s money there.

t: 相簿；唱片集；集邮簿；签名纪念册
words.s: He showed me his photograph album.
words.sz: 他給我看了他的影集。

words.s: I had to change clothes because what I was wearing wasn't appropriate for the situation.
words.sz: 我必须要换衣服，因为我现在穿的衣服不适合这个环境。
words.d: When a thing is appropriate, it is right or normal.

words.s: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
words.sz: 死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

words.s: This data isn't accurate at all.
words.sz: 這個數據一點也不準確。
words.d: If something is accurate, it is completely correct.

words.s: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
words.sz: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
words.d: Alcohol is a type of drink that can make people drunk.

words.s: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
words.sz: 如果您同意,我想給他這份工作。

t: 可怕的；极坏的；使人敬畏的
words.s: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
words.sz: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。
words.d: An awful thing is very bad.

words.s: She accused her brother of breaking her computer.
words.d: To accuse someone of something is to blame them for doing it.

words.s: People who drink alcoholic beverages are not allowed to enter.
words.sz: 飲酒者不准禁入。

t: 批准，核准，通过；赞成，同意
words.s: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
words.sz: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。
words.d: To approve of something means you like or agree with that thing.

t: 纵容，娇纵；把……当婴儿般对待
words.s: It was not until I had a baby myself that I knew what mother's love is.
words.sz: 直到我自己有了孩子我才明白了什么是母爱。

t: 凭长期努力达到某目标、地位、标准；完成，成功
words.s: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.
words.sz: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。
words.d: To achieve something is to successfully do it after trying hard.

t: 活着的；活泼的；有生气的
words.s: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
words.sz: 要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。
words.d: Someone or something that is alive is not dead.

words.s: Approximately thirty young people attended.
words.sz: 約有三十箇年輕人到了。

t: 后面；背部；靠背；足球等的后卫；书报等的末尾
以前；向后地；来回地；上溯；回来；回原处
words.s: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
words.sz: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。

words.s: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.
words.sz: 登月是一項里程碑式的成就。

words.s: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
words.sz: 現在我們什麼也做不了，救不了湯姆。我們唯一能做的就是祈禱。

words.s: We'll have lived here for two years next April.
words.sz: 到明年四月我们住在这儿就满两年了。

words.s: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
words.sz: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
words.d: A background is a person’s education, family, and experience.

words.s: The teacher acknowledged that the young student was hungry.
words.d: To acknowledge something is to accept that it is true or that it exists.

t: 建筑师，设计师；缔造者，创造者
words.s: A famous architect built this house.
words.sz: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。
words.d: An architect is a person who designs buildings.

words.s: Tina acquired a strange package yesterday.
words.d: To acquire something is to get or gain possession of that thing.

words.s: For quantities of 20 or more, we can allow you a special discount of 10% on the prices quoted.
words.sz: 20个以上九折特惠。
words.d: To allow something to happen means to let it happen.

t: 建筑学，建筑术；建筑风格，建筑式样
words.s: You like to talk about architecture, don't you?
words.sz: 你喜欢讨论建筑，不是吗？
words.d: Architecture is the design and form of a building.

words.s: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
words.sz: CharlesLindbergh於1927年成功完成了第一次獨自飛越大西洋。
words.d: To go across something is to go to the other side of it.

words.s: Tom can write almost like a native speaker, but his pronunciation is terrible.
words.sz: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂

words.s: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
words.sz: 据说这个区域埋着财宝。
words.d: An area is a reasonably large place.

words.s: I'm the type who gets nervous in front of people, so I'm bad at speech making.
words.sz: 我是那种面对人群很紧张的人，所以我的演讲能力很差。
words.d: When something is bad, it is not good.

t: 行动，做事；起作用；表演，扮演
words.s: You are old enough to know better than to act like that.
words.sz: 你夠大了知道不要那樣做。

words.s: The kidnapper told me he'd kill Tom if I didn't show up alone.
words.sz: 绑匪告诉我我如果不独自出现他就会把汤姆杀了。
words.d: A person who is alone is not with another person.

words.s: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
words.sz: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。

t: adv. 非常，很；严重地，厉害地；恶劣地
words.s: She was very embarrassed when her child behaved badly in public.
words.sz: 當她的孩子在公共場合行為表現不好的時候，她覺得很尷尬。

words.s: Action speaks louder than words, but not nearly as often.
words.sz: 行胜于言，但并不是所有情况都是这样。

words.s: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.
words.sz: 一辈子只会出现一次像这样的机会。
words.d: Along means down the length of a road, river, etc.

words.s: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
words.sz: 經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。

t: 猎获；把…装入袋中；占据，私吞；使膨大
words.s: His bag is right here, so he cannot have gone to school yet.
words.sz: 他的包就在这儿，所以他不可能已经去了学校。

words.s: The volcano has become active again.
words.sz: 這座火山又開始活動了。
words.d: When someone is active, they move a lot or have a lot of things to do.

words.s: My father had already finished breakfast when I got up this morning.
words.sz: 我今早起床时，我爸已经吃过早饭了。
words.d: If something happens already, it happens before a certain time.

t: 形成，产生，出现；上升，升起；起立，起身
words.s: Difficulties arose with his computer because it was old.
words.d: To arise is to happen.

words.s: My sister is a good cook. She bakes delicious cakes.
words.d: To bake means to cook food in an oven.

words.s: Watching TV is a passive activity.
words.sz: 看電視是一種被動的活動。

words.s: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.
words.sz: 电视的确有一些缺点。
words.d: Also means in addition to or too.

words.s: Let go of my arm! I can't stand people touching me.
words.sz: 放開我的手臂！我不能忍受有人碰我。

words.s: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
words.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。
words.d: Balance is when two or more things are equal.

words.s: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
words.sz: 你想成為一名電影演員嗎？

words.s: I altered the color of my nails to match my hair.
words.d: To alter something means to change it.

t: adj. 武装的, 带枪的有把手的,有扶手的有防护器官的待发射的；解除保险的武装到牙齿；全副武装
words.s: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.
words.sz: 军队占领了整片领土。
words.d: If you are armed, you are carrying a weapon.

words.s: Seen from the moon, the earth looks like a ball.
words.sz: 从月球上看的话，地球看起来像个皮球。
words.d: A ball is a round object that is thrown, kicked, or hit in a game or sport.

words.s: It's said that she's a well-known actress.
words.sz: 我聽說她是個有名的演員。

t: 两者挑一的；可供选择的
words.s: Her first plan to make extra money seemed weak, so she chose an alternative.
words.d: An alternative is something that you can choose instead of your first choice.

t: n. 臂（arm的复数）；[军] 武器；纹章
v. 武装；配备（arm的三单形式）
words.s: The moment I held the baby in my arms, it began to cry.
words.sz: 我一把孩子抱在手里，他就开始哭了。

words.s: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
words.sz: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
words.d: To ban something is to not let people do it.

words.s: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
words.sz: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
words.d: Actual means real or true.

words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。
words.d: You use although to say that one thing is contrasted by another.

words.s: I had been in the army for a month when the war ended.
words.sz: 戰爭結束的時候，我已經在軍隊裡待了一箇月。
words.d: An army is a large group of people who fight in wars.

t: 香蕉；喜剧演员；大鹰钩鼻
words.s: Have you ever eaten a banana pie?
words.sz: 你吃过香蕉派吗？
words.d: A banana is a long yellow fruit with soft white flesh inside.

words.s: You didn't actually want to go to Australia, did you?
words.sz: 你其實不想去澳大利亞吧？
words.d: Actually means in fact or really.

words.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
words.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
words.d: Always means that something happens all the time.

words.s: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
words.sz: Mary试图把围裙围在腰上，然后把烤鸡从炉子里拿出来。

words.s: It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.
words.sz: 很難找到一位沒有在其他樂團工作的優秀主唱。
words.d: A band is a group of people who play music.

t: v. 使…吃惊；把…弄糊涂（amaze的过去分词）
words.s: If I were to tell you all I know, you would be amazed.
words.sz: 要是我告诉你我所知的一切，你会被惊呆的。

words.s: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
words.sz: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。
words.d: To arrange things is to put them in the right place.

words.s: There's a lot of trash on the far bank of the river.
words.sz: 河對岸有很多的垃圾。

words.s: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.
words.sz: 我适应新环境很慢。
words.d: To adapt means to change in order to deal with a new situation.

words.s: What we've accomplished is amazing.
words.sz: 我們所取得的成就令人驚嘆。

words.s: Is there anything you want to add to what I just said?
words.sz: 我刚才说的内容，你想补充么？

t: （对名利等的）强烈欲望，野心；雄心，抱负；追求的目标
words.s: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
words.sz: 以前，玛丽想和一位有雄心壮志的男人结婚。
words.d: Ambition is the desire to succeed and to become the best at something.

words.s: Why don't the police arrest Tom?
words.sz: 为什么警察不逮捕Tom？
words.d: To arrest someone means to catch that person for doing something bad.

words.s: If you sang, they'd kick you out of the bar.
words.sz: 如果你唱歌了，他们就会把你踢出酒吧。

words.s: In addition to English, he speaks German.
words.sz: 除了英文，他還說德文。

t: 有雄心的，野心勃勃的；费力的；耗时的；耗资的；艰巨的
words.s: Kendra had to be ambitious to get into medical school.
words.d: An ambitious person wants to be rich or successful.

words.s: Ladies and gentlemen, due to an accident at the airport, our arrival will be delayed.
words.sz: 女士們，先生們，由於機場的意外情況，我們的著陸將被推遲。

words.s: The Great Wall was a barrier between China and its enemies.
words.d: A barrier is something that blocks a path or way.

words.s: Tom became popular among teenagers as soon as he made his debut on the screen.
words.sz: 汤姆第一次上电视后就广受青少年的欢迎。
words.d: If you are among certain things, they are all around you.

words.s: "Do you know when they will arrive?" "At eleven-thirty this evening."
words.sz: 你知道他们什么时候到吗？今晚11点半。
words.d: To arrive is to get somewhere.

t: 基础，底部，底座；基地，根据地；把...基于
words.s: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.
words.sz: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。
words.d: The base is the bottom of something.

t: 演说；住址，地址；对付，处理
words.s: He said that if he knew her address, he would write to her.
words.sz: 他说如果他知道她的地址，他会写信给她。

words.s: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
words.sz: 已經花費了很多的時間和精力。
words.d: An amount is how much there is of something.

words.s: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
words.sz: 線條藝術強調形式和輪廓，而不是顏色、陰影和紋理。
words.d: Art is something creative that expresses ideas and feelings.

words.s: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
words.sz: 他喜歡看電視上的棒球比賽。

words.s: Everyone in the store did whatever the administrator asked them to do.
words.d: An administrator is a person who controls a business, company, or organization.

t: 文章；物品；条款；[语] 冠词
订约将…收为学徒或见习生；使…受协议条款的约束
words.s: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
words.sz: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。
words.d: An article is a story in a newspaper or magazine.

t: adj. 有根基的;有基地的
words.s: True friendship is based on mutual trust.
words.sz: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。

t: adj. 人造的；仿造的；虚伪的；非原产地的；武断的
words.s: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: If something is artificial, it was not made naturally but mimics something natural.

words.s: Mathematics is basic to all sciences.
words.sz: 數學是所有科學的基礎。
words.d: If something is basic, it is very simple or easy.

words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

t: 古代的， 古老的； 年老的， 看上去很老的
words.s: Rome has a lot of ancient buildings.
words.sz: 罗马有很多古建筑。
words.d: If something is ancient, it is very old.

words.s: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
words.sz: 給這本書畫插畫的畫家很好。
words.d: An artist is a person who paints, draws, or makes sculptures.

t: 基本上， 从根本上说
采用，采纳；正式通过，批准；继承；收养
words.s: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
words.sz: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。

t: conj. 和，与，而且；那么；接连，又
words.s: Tom gave Mary a box of chocolates, and then ate all the chocolates himself.
words.sz: 汤姆给了玛丽一盒巧克力，然后自己把全部巧克力都吃掉了。

t: 艺术的， 艺术家的； 富有艺术性的， 精美的； 精彩的
words.s: He was raised in an artistic family.
words.sz: 他在艺术世家长大。

words.s: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
words.sz: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。
words.d: The basis of something is the main part of amount of it.

t: 成年人的，成熟的；成年人
words.s: Two adult tickets and three children's tickets to London, please.
words.sz: 请给我两张到伦敦的成人票，三张儿童票。
words.d: An adult is a person who is more than 18 years old.

words.s: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.
words.sz: 總理的發言估計激怒了在野黨。

words.s: As I missed the train, I had to wait for the next one for about an hour.
words.sz: 由于错过了火车，我不得不等下一班等一小时。

words.s: I knew Tom would be a good basketball coach. That's why I hired him.
words.sz: 我知道汤姆会成为一位优秀的篮球教练。这就是为什么我聘用了他。

t: 使向前移动；促进；提出建议；提前发生；前进，进展
words.s: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
words.sz: 地面高低不平，給部隊前進帶來了困難。
words.d: To advance is to go forward.

t: 有利条件，优点；（尤指采取某一步骤而带来的）好处，利益
words.s: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
words.sz: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

t: 冒险；冒险精神；投机活动
words.s: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
words.sz: 他写了一本关于丛林冒险的书。
words.d: An adventure is a fun or exciting thing that you do.

words.s: We advertise our products on TV.
words.sz: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。
words.d: To advertise is to describe or draw attention to a product or event by using a public medium.

words.s: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
words.sz: 那家公司在广告上花了很多钱。

words.s: None of this would've been necessary if we'd followed Tom's advice.
words.sz: 如果我们照了汤姆的话去做这一切都是没必要的。
words.d: Advice is an opinion about what to do.

words.s: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
words.sz: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。
words.d: To advise someone is to tell them what to do.

t: 事情，事件；事务，业务，事态
words.s: I have nothing to do with the affair.
words.sz: 我跟這件事無關。
words.d: An affair is an event or a thing that happened.

words.s: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
words.sz: 其他人的期望會影響我們的行為。
words.d: To affect someone or something is to have an influence over them.

words.s: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
words.sz: 法國是一個福利國家，但它卻不再能夠負擔得起了。
words.d: To afford something means to have enough money to pay for it.

words.s: Afraid of hurting his feelings, I didn't tell him the truth.
words.sz: 怕傷害了他的感情，我沒有告訴他真相。

words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.s: I want this work completed by two o'clock tomorrow afternoon.
words.sz: 明天下午2点以前，我希望这工作完成了。

words.s: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
words.sz: 婚前張開眼，婚後半閉眼。

t: 又，此外；再一次；再说；增加
words.s: She told me once and for all that she did not want to see me again.
words.sz: 她一劳永逸地告诉我，她不想再见我了。

words.s: You seem to be prejudiced against ideas that come from foreign countries.
words.sz: 你似乎對來自國外的想法有偏見。
words.d: To be against something is to be touching it or opposed to it.

t: 年龄；时代；寿命，使用年限；阶段
words.s: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.
words.sz: 在美國，大多數人能在十八歲以後投票。
words.d: Age is how many years someone has lived.

words.s: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
words.sz: 90度的角叫直角。
words.d: An angle is the direction from which something is looked at.

t: 生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的
words.s: That was the first time that I'd seen Tom so angry.
words.sz: 那是我第一次见到汤姆如此生气。

words.s: Man is the only animal that can make use of fire.
words.sz: 人是唯一会使用火的动物。
words.d: An animal is a living thing that can move.

words.s: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
words.sz: 她锻炼时扭伤了脚踝。
words.d: An ankle connects your leg to your foot.

words.s: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
words.sz: 湯姆從沒忘記在婚禮周年紀念日送給他妻子花。
words.d: An anniversary is a day that celebrates something from the past.

words.s: Tom found a new way to announce his news.
words.sz: 汤姆发现了一种宣布他新闻的新方法。
words.d: To announce something is to make it known.

t: 使恼怒，使生气；打搅，骚扰
words.s: He made mistakes on purpose to annoy me.
words.sz: 他为了惹恼我故意犯错。

t: v.使烦恼；打扰（annoy的过去分词）adj.恼怒的；烦闷的
words.s: He was always annoyed in the city by noises of one sort or another.
words.sz: 他在城市里一直受到噪音或者其他的干扰。

words.s: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
words.sz: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。

t: 每年的，年度的，一年一次的；年报，年刊，年鉴
words.s: I don't know my father's annual income.
words.sz: 我不知到我爸的年收入是多少。
words.d: An annual event happens once a year.

t: 又一，另一；另外的；不同的
words.s: It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.
words.sz: 很難找到一位沒有在其他樂團工作的優秀主唱。

words.s: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
words.sz: 我們已經收到了很多回應我們廣告的申請。

t: 焦虑的，发愁的；渴望的，急切的
words.s: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
words.sz: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
words.d: Anxious means feeling worried or nervous.

words.s: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
words.sz: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。

words.s: Tom asked me if I knew anybody who could translate from French into English.
words.sz: 湯姆問我是否認識可以做法英翻譯的人。

words.s: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
words.sz: 我知道不太可能有人願意幫助我。

words.s: Everybody talks about the weather, but nobody does anything about it.
words.sz: 每個人都在談論天氣,但是沒有人為它做任何事情。

words.s: I'm very ashamed of myself about what I've done.
words.sz: 我對自己的作為很內疚。
words.d: Ashamed means feeling upset and embarrassed because of a bad action.

t: 问，询问；要求；需要；邀请；讨价
words.s: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?
words.sz: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
words.d: To ask is to say or write something to get an answer.

words.s: While I was reading in bed last night, I fell asleep with the light on.
words.sz: 我昨晚在床上看书的时候点着灯就睡了。

words.s: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
words.sz: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。
words.d: An aspect is one part or feature of something.

words.s: She can assess investments very accurately.
words.sz: 她能很准确地评估投资。
words.d: To assess something means to judge the structure, purpose, or quality of it.

words.s: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
words.sz: 我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。
words.d: An assignment is task that is given to you to do.

words.s: I'll be able to assist you.
words.sz: 我能協助你。
words.d: To assist someone is to help them.

words.s: I worked three years as Tom's assistant.
words.sz: 我给汤姆当了三年助手。

words.s: We often associate black with death.
words.sz: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。
words.d: To associate means to connect something with a person or thing.

t: 协会，团体；联合，联系，交往；联想
words.s: I applied for membership in the association.
words.sz: 我申請成為協會會員。

t: 呈现，具有；承担，担任；假定，假设；假装，装出
words.s: Let's assume that'll happen.
words.sz: 讓我們假定那會發生。
words.d: To assume something is to think that it is true, even with no proof.

t: 在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；以（某种价格、速度等）；向；达；因为；朝；忙于
阿特（老挝货币基本单位att）；[化]砹（极不稳定放射性元素）
words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.s: Tom is a natural athlete.
words.sz: 汤姆天生就是个运动员。
words.d: An athlete is a person who plays sports.

t: 大气，空气；气氛，环境；大气压
words.s: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
words.sz: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。
words.d: The atmosphere is the air around the Earth where weather conditions form.

t: 连接，使成为一部分；使喜爱，使依恋；认为有（重要性等）
words.s: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
words.sz: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。
words.d: To attach is to put two things together.

t: 攻击，进攻，抨击；开始，着手
words.s: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
words.sz: 敵人對那棟建築物使出了強力攻擊。
words.d: To attack something is to hurt or damage it.

words.s: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
words.sz: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
words.d: An attempt is an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult.

words.s: I was having a bath when the telephone rang.
words.sz: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。
words.d: A bath is the act of sitting in a tub of water in order to get clean.

words.s: I sometimes hear my father singing in the bathroom.
words.sz: 我有時會聽到父親在浴室裡唱歌。

words.s: Remove the battery.
words.sz: 卸下電池。
words.d: A battery is an object placed inside something to supply it with electricity.

words.s: This is the place where the battle of Hastings took place.
words.sz: 這裡是黑斯廷斯戰役發生的地方。
words.d: A battle is a fight between two armies during a war.

t: 是； 有，存在； 做，成为； 发生
(Be)人名；(缅)拜；(日)部(姓)；(朝)培；(中非)贝
words.s: Tom said Mary thought that John might be permitted to do that next weekend.
words.sz: 汤姆说玛丽觉得约翰下周末可能被允许那么做。

words.s: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.
words.sz: 我本来预备今天去海滩的，但接着天就开始下雨了。
words.d: The beach is a sandy or rocky place by the ocean.

words.s: There are many different kinds of beans to eat.
words.d: A bean is a plant seed that is good to eat.

words.s: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.
words.sz: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。

t: 拍子；敲击；有规律的一连串敲打
筋疲力尽的；疲惫不堪的
words.s: Don't beat around the bush.
words.sz: 不要拐彎抹角。
words.d: To beat someone means to do better than they do.

words.s: You said Mary was beautiful, but I didn't think she would be this beautiful.
words.sz: 你说玛丽很美丽，但我没有想到她是这么美丽。
words.d: A beautiful thing is good to look at.

words.s: Switzerland is famous for its scenic beauty.
words.sz: 瑞士以它的風景優美而聞名。
words.d: Beauty is the state or quality of being beautiful.

words.s: I had to cancel that order because we didn't have enough money to pay for it.
words.sz: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
words.d: Because introduces a reason for something.

t: 成为，变得；适宜，同...相称；使人显得漂亮，使好看
words.s: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
words.sz: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。

words.s: While I was reading in bed last night, I fell asleep with the light on.
words.sz: 我昨晚在床上看书的时候点着灯就睡了。

t: 两性关系的；城郊住宅区的
words.s: I could hear her sobbing in her bedroom.
words.sz: 我能聽到她在臥室裡抽泣。

words.s: Bee stings can be very painful.
words.sz: 蜜蜂螫人可以是非常痛苦的。

words.s: Beef is usually more expensive than pork.
words.sz: 牛肉通常比豬肉貴。

words.s: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
words.sz: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

words.s: Many parents think it's important for their children to eat before 8:00 p.m.
words.sz: 許多父母認為讓自己的子女在下午八點前吃完飯是很重要的。

words.s: I beg your pardon?
words.sz: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？

words.s: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.
words.sz: 工作之前先收好思绪。

t: 开端，开始；初始阶段，源于
words.s: I hope that this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
words.sz: 希望這是美好友誼的開始。

t: 举止端正，听话；表现；运转
words.s: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
words.sz: 其他人的期望會影響我們的行為。
words.d: To behave is to act in a particular way, especially to be good.

words.s: I didn't know that Tom talked about me like that behind my back.
words.sz: 我不知道湯姆在我後面說我壞話
words.d: Behind means to be at the back of something.

words.s: Being a good conversationalist does not just mean being a good speaker of English.
words.sz: 作為一個良好的交談者，並不只意味著作一個英語說得好的說話者。

words.s: It's my belief that knowledge is power.
words.sz: 我相信，知识就是力量。
words.d: A belief is a strong feeling that something is correct or true.

t: 相信，信任；信仰；相信存在
words.s: It's hard to believe that Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
words.sz: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。

words.s: As soon as she heard the bell ring, she answered the telephone.
words.sz: 她一聽到鈴響，就接了電話。

t: 属于，附属，隶属；应归入（类别、范畴等）
words.s: Iceland used to belong to Denmark.
words.sz: 冰島以前屬於丹麥。

t: 在下面，在较低处；在本页下面
words.s: Use a dictionary to find the meanings of the phrases below.
words.sz: 用字典查出下面词组的意思。

t: 用带子系住；用皮带抽打
words.s: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
words.sz: 要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。

t: 使弯曲；使屈服；使致力；使朝向
words.s: I can't bend my right arm.
words.sz: 我無法彎曲我的右手臂。
words.d: To bend is to move something so it is not straight.

t: 利益，好处，恩惠；有益于，受益于
words.s: Being able to fly is a benefit to birds.
words.d: A benefit is a good thing.

words.s: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
words.sz: 汤姆弯下腰，捧起了一把沙子。

words.s: Tom did the best he could, but he wasn't able to get a higher grade than Mary.
words.sz: 汤姆尽了全力，但他还是不能获得比玛丽更高的等级。
words.d: The best person or thing is better than all the others.

t: 打赌，赌注；被打赌的事物
words.s: I made a bet that she would win the game.
words.sz: 我賭她贏這比賽。
words.d: To bet is to risk money on the result of a game or a business.

t: n. 长辈；较好者；打赌的人（等于bettor）
adv. 更好的；更多的；较大程度地
words.s: After I got married, my Japanese got better and I could understand more.
words.sz: 在我结婚之后，我的日语水平提高了，能理解更多日语了。

words.s: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
words.sz: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？

words.s: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
words.sz: 你看過富士山嗎?它美得無法形容。
words.d: Beyond is used to say that one thing is more than another.

words.s: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
words.sz: 因為空氣汙染的問題，也許有一天自行車會取代汽車。
words.d: A bicycle is a two-wheeled vehicle powered by pedaling.

words.s: If you want to go, then go. If you don't want to, then it's no big deal.
words.sz: 如果你想去，就去好了。如果你不想去，那也没什么大不了的。

words.s: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.
words.sz: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。
words.d: A bike is a vehicle with two wheels powered by a human.

t: 账单；招贴，广告；法案；单子，清单；钞票
words.s: The bill was passed after a hard fight in the House.
words.sz: 該法案在眾議院爭議後獲得通過。
words.d: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or for a service.

words.s: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
words.sz: 那家公司去年亏损了10亿日元。
words.d: A billion is a very large number: 1,000,000,000.

words.s: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.
words.sz: 他是哈佛大学的生物学教授。
words.d: Biology is the study of living things.

words.s: A bird in the hand is better than two in the bush.
words.sz: 一鳥在手勝過二鳥在林。

words.s: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
words.sz: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

words.s: Tom began to sing "Happy Birthday" and the entire restaurant joined in.
words.sz: 汤姆开始唱“祝你生日快乐”，然后整个餐厅的人都加入了进来。

t: [计] 比特（二进位制信息单位）；少量；马嚼子；辅币；老一套；一点，一块
words.s: I know you've been waiting a long time, but could you wait just a little bit longer?
words.sz: 我知道你已经等很久了，但你能再等一小会吗？
words.d: A bit is a small amount of something.

t: 机内测试设备（Built-In Test Equipment）
words.s: If you bite me, I'll bite you back.
words.sz: 如果你咬我，我就咬回来。
words.d: Bite is the act of using your teeth to cut and tear into something.

t: 苦的；痛苦的；尖刻的；充满仇恨的
words.s: They are bitter enemies.
words.sz: 他們是仇敵。
words.d: A bitter person feels upset or angry about something.

t: 使变黑；把鞋油等涂在…上；把（眼眶）打成青肿
words.s: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
words.sz: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
words.d: Black is the darkest color.

words.s: None of us thought he was to blame for the accident.
words.sz: 我們都不認為他是事故的罪魁禍首。
words.d: To blame someone for something bad is to say they did it.

words.s: She got a blank piece of paper to draw on.
words.d: When something is blank, it does not have anything on it.

words.s: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.
words.sz: 他很快便与小区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。
words.d: A block is a solid piece of wood, stone, or ice.

t: v. 写博客 n. 博客，网络日志
words.s: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
words.sz: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

words.s: Mary prefers to dye her hair blonde.
words.sz: 玛丽更想把头发染成金色。
words.d: A blonde is a person with light-colored hair.

words.s: A connection between personality and blood type has not been scientifically proven.
words.sz: 科学上，血型和性格的关联性没有被证明。

words.s: Blow out all the candles on the birthday cake at once.
words.sz: 一口气吹灭生日蛋糕上所有的蜡烛。
words.d: To blow means to move air or move something through the air, as in the wind.

t: 蓝色；[复数]（美国海、陆、空三军穿的）蓝色制服；蓝颜料；[the blue(s)][用作单数或复数]布鲁斯（歌曲）（一种伤感的美国黑人民歌
蓝色的；沮丧的，忧郁的；下流的
把…染成蓝色；使成蓝色；给…用上蓝剂；用上蓝剂于
words.s: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.
words.sz: 美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。

t: 板，木板；理事会，委员会；伙食；膳食费用；上船（车，飞机）
words.s: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
words.sz: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。
words.d: A board is a flat piece of wood.

words.s: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
words.sz: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
words.d: A boat is a vehicle that moves across water.

t: 身体；主体；大量；团体；主要部分
words.s: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
words.sz: 人會因為體溫而在紅外線攝影機上顯現。

words.s: I'll boil the potatoes for you.
words.sz: 我為你煮馬鈴薯。

words.s: In London, the police are always worried about finding a bomb on the train or subway.
words.sz: 在倫敦，警察總是擔心在列車或地鐵上發現炸彈。
words.d: A bomb is an object that explodes and destroys large areas.

t: 债券；结合；约定；粘合剂；纽带
words.s: The women bonded after several hours of conversation.
words.d: To bond with someone is to become friends with that person.

t: 书籍；卷；帐簿；名册；工作簿
words.s: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
words.sz: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。
words.d: A book is a set of printed sheets of paper that are held together inside a cover.

words.s: He wore boots so that his feet wouldn’t get wet.
words.d: A boot is a heavy shoe that goes up above a person’s ankle.

words.s: I was asked to show my passport at the border.
words.sz: 在邊境上，我被要求出示我的護照。
words.d: A border is the edge of an area.

words.s: Mary seems to be bored with the game.
words.sz: 瑪麗似乎對這個遊戲感到無聊。

t: 令人厌烦的， 乏味的， 无聊的
words.s: My first day in the university was rather boring.
words.sz: 我大学里的第一天相当没意思。
words.d: If something is boring, it is not fun.

t: 出身于...的，天生的，生来的
words.s: Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, was born in a log cabin in Kentucky.
words.sz: 伯拉罕·林肯，美国第16任总统，生于肯塔基州的一个简陋的小屋里。

t: 借；借用；从其他语言中引入
words.s: Father ran short of money and had to borrow some.
words.sz: 父親缺錢，所以他必須去借點錢。
words.d: To borrow something is to take it and then give it back later.

words.s: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.
words.sz: 当他老板发现真相的时候，谎言给他带来了麻烦。
words.d: A boss is a person in charge of other people at work.

words.s: I've never lived on a farm, but both of my parents grew up on farms.
words.sz: 我從沒有在農場住，但我的父母都在農場長大。

words.s: I'm sorry to bother you so often.
words.sz: 一直打扰你不好意思。
words.d: To bother is to make the effort to do something.

words.s: There's a bottle of white wine in the refrigerator.
words.sz: 冰箱裡有一瓶白葡萄酒。

t: 装底；测量深浅；查明真相
words.s: She is always at the bottom of the class.
words.sz: 她总是在班上拿倒数第一。
words.d: The bottom is the lowest part, point, or level of something.

t: 玩保龄球；滑动；平稳快速移动
words.s: The dog is sitting by the bowl.
words.sz: 狗坐在碗旁边。
words.d: A bowl is a dish with a round deep shape.

words.s: Tom gave Mary a box of chocolates, and then ate all the chocolates himself.
words.sz: 汤姆给了玛丽一盒巧克力，然后自己把全部巧克力都吃掉了。

words.s: Tom and Mary's little boy loves sitting on the kitchen floor banging pots and pans.
words.sz: 湯姆和瑪莉的小兒子喜歡坐在廚房地板上敲打鍋碗瓢盆。

words.s: He's a very romantic boyfriend who brings me flowers each night.
words.sz: 他是箇非常浪漫的男朋友，每晚都給我送花。

words.s: He's an excellent brain surgeon.
words.sz: 他是一個優秀的腦外科醫生。
words.d: The brain is the organ in your head that lets you think.

t: 树枝，分支；分布；分店；支流，支脉
words.s: A new branch will be opened in Chicago next month.
words.sz: 新的分店下箇月在芝加哥開始營業。
words.d: A branch is the part of a tree with leaves.

words.s: It's brand new.
words.sz: 这是全新的。

words.s: His brave deed earned him respect.
words.sz: 他的英勇行為使他贏得了尊重。
words.d: A brave person is not afraid to face pain or danger.

words.s: I just remembered that I was supposed to buy a loaf of bread.
words.sz: 我才想起来我之前该买个面包。
words.d: Bread is a food made from flour and water.

t: 打断，中止；休息时间；打破，折断
words.s: Tom returned to his hometown to visit his parents during the summer break.
words.sz: 汤姆在夏休回乡看望父母。

words.s: Every morning she helps her mother to prepare breakfast in the kitchen.
words.sz: 她每天早上都帮母亲在厨房准备早餐。
words.d: Breakfast is the morning meal.

words.s: She was diagnosed with breast cancer.
words.d: A breast is one of the two soft parts on a woman’s chest.

t: 呼吸，气息；一口气，（呼吸的）一次；瞬间，瞬息；微风；迹象；无声音，气音
words.s: Everyone held their breath to see who would win the presidential election.
words.sz: 所有人都屏住呼吸关注着谁会赢得总统竞选。
words.d: A breath is the air that goes into and out of one’s lungs.

t: 呼吸；低语；松口气；（风）轻拂
words.s: I want to breathe some fresh air.
words.sz: 我想呼吸一下新鮮空氣。
words.d: To breathe means to let air go in and out of your body.

words.s: I shot the horse because it had trouble breathing.
words.sz: 我枪杀了那匹马，因为他已呼吸困难。

words.s: The bride seems to be very pretty.
words.sz: 新娘好像非常漂亮。

words.s: We enjoyed watching the fireworks on a bridge last summer.
words.sz: 去年夏天，我们在桥上看焰火看得很过瘾。
words.d: A bridge is something that is built over a river so people can cross it.

t: 短时间的，短暂的；简短的，简洁的
words.s: The lawyers took a brief break.
words.d: A brief action lasts a short time.

t: 明亮的，鲜明的；聪明的；愉快的
words.s: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
words.sz: 人會因為體溫而在紅外線攝影機上顯現。
words.d: If something is bright, it gives off a lot of light.

words.s: A brilliant future lay before him.
words.sz: 大好的前途摆在他面前。
words.d: A brilliant person is very bright or smart.

t: 带来, 拿来, 取来
words.s: Please bring us two cups of tea and one cup of coffee.
words.sz: 请来两杯茶和一杯咖啡。

t: 宽的，辽阔的；显著的；大概的
words.s: Tom has very broad shoulders.
words.sz: 汤姆肩膀很宽。
words.d: Broad means that something is wide, not narrow.

t: 播送，播放；（无线电或电视）广播；播撒（种子）
words.s: That program is now being broadcast.
words.sz: 那個節目現在正在播出。
words.d: A broadcast is a television or radio show.

words.s: They accused me of having broken my promise.
words.sz: 他们指责我没有信守诺言。

words.s: He cut it with the knife that he received as a present from his brother.
words.sz: 他用哥哥送給他的刀子切開了。

t: 刷子；画笔；毛笔；争吵；与某人有效冲突；灌木丛地带；矮树丛；狐狸尾巴
words.s: Most people brush their teeth at least two times a day.
words.sz: 多数人每天至少刷两次牙。

t: 泡，水泡，气泡；幻想的计划，无法实现的意念、希望等
预期，财政收支状况；做预算，编预算；把...编入预算，按计划花钱
words.s: We are traveling on a tight budget.
words.sz: 我們很節省地旅行。
words.d: A budget is the amount of money available to spend on something.

t: 体形，体格，身材；建造，建设， 建立
words.s: You can't build buildings on swampy land.
words.sz: 你不能在沼澤地上建造建築物。

words.s: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
words.sz: 紐約帝國大廈現在完全依靠風力發電。

words.s: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
words.sz: 湯姆穿著一件防彈衣，所以子彈沒把他殺死。
words.d: A bullet is a small metal object that is shot out of a gun.

words.s: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.
words.sz: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。
words.d: A bunch is a group of the same things.

words.s: When you've finished reading this letter, burn it.
words.sz: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。
words.d: To burn is to use something as a source of energy.

words.s: My father was buried in his hometown when he died.
words.d: When you bury something, you put it under the ground or under a lot of other things.

words.s: There were only three passengers on the bus when it exploded.
words.sz: 当汽车爆炸时，车上只有三名乘客。
words.d: A bus is a large vehicle that people travel on.

words.s: A bird in the hand is better than two in the bush.
words.sz: 一鳥在手勝過二鳥在林。
words.d: A bush is a woody plant that is smaller than a tree.

t: 商业，生意，营业额；任务，职责，公事；企业，公司，店铺，商号
words.s: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
words.sz: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。

words.s: Tom seems to be a fairly successful businessman.
words.sz: 湯姆看來是箇很成功的商人。

t: 忙碌的；热闹的；正被占用的
words.s: I was busy packing, because I was leaving for France in two days.
words.sz: 我当时正忙着打包，因为我两天后要去法国。
words.d: A busy person has a lot of things to do.

words.s: At first, he thought English very difficult, but now he thinks it is easy.
words.sz: 起初他以为英语很难，如今他觉得很简单。

words.s: I like to eat honey and peanut butter sandwiches.
words.sz: 我喜歡吃蜂蜜花生醬三明治。

words.s: All you have to do is push this button to take a picture.
words.sz: 你要做的就是按这个按钮拍照。

words.s: I wonder whether we have enough money to buy Tom the painting he wanted.
words.sz: 我想知道咱们是否有足够的钱给汤姆买他想要的这幅画。

t: 通过；被；依据；经由；在附近；在……之前
通过；经过；附近；[互联网] 白俄罗斯的国家代码顶级域名
words.s: By the way, did you find the umbrella you said you'd lost the other day?
words.sz: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？

words.s: Monica works part-time at a café.
words.d: A café is a small restaurant where you can buy drinks and simple meals.

words.s: The cake should just about be ready to be taken out of the oven.
words.sz: 蛋糕應該差不多可以出爐了。
words.d: Cake is a sweet dessert made from flour, water, sugar, and eggs.

words.s: I calculated how much money I would need to buy the car.
words.d: To calculate is to find an answer using math.

t: 喊，叫；打电话；把...叫做，称呼，称为
words.s: I'd like to make a call to Tokyo, Japan. The number is 3202-5625.
words.sz: 我想要打个电话到日本东京，号码是3202－5625。

words.s: I was calm until I saw the syringe.
words.sz: 看到针管儿之前我一直都很淡定。
words.d: When someone is calm, they do not get excited or upset.

words.s: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
words.sz: 人會因為體溫而在紅外線攝影機上顯現。
words.d: A camera is a piece of equipment that takes pictures.

words.s: We found it very hard going back to our base camp in the blizzard.
words.sz: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。

t: 战役；运动，竞选活动；发起活动，开展活动

words.s: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
words.sz: 經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。

words.s: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
words.sz: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。

t: 能； 能够； 可以； 可能
罐头； （用金属或塑料制作的）容器； （马口铁或其他金属制作的）食品罐头
words.s: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
words.sz: 現在我們什麼也做不了，救不了湯姆。我們唯一能做的就是祈禱。
words.d: Can shows that a person or thing has the ability to do an action.

words.s: I had to cancel that order because we didn't have enough money to pay for it.
words.sz: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
words.d: To cancel means to decide that an event or a request will not happen.

words.s: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.
words.sz: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。
words.d: Cancer is a serious disease that causes cells to grow abnormally.

words.s: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
words.sz: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。
words.d: A candidate is a person who is competing to win something such as a job.

words.s: His bag is right here, so he cannot have gone to school yet.
words.sz: 他的包就在这儿，所以他不可能已经去了学校。

words.s: I paid ten dollars for this cap.
words.sz: 我付了十美元買這頂帽子。

words.s: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
words.sz: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。
words.d: A capable person or thing can do an action.

t: 才能，能力；生产力；接受能力；容量，容积
words.s: The room has a seating capacity of 200.
words.sz: 这个房间能容纳200人。
words.d: The capacity of something is the amount of things that can be put in it.

t: 首都，首府；大写字母；资本，资金
words.s: A capital letter is used at the beginning of a sentence.
words.sz: 一個句子以一個大寫字母開始。
words.d: A capital is a city where a country’s government is based.

t: 队长，首领；船长；上尉；海军上校
words.s: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
words.sz: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
words.d: A captain is the person who controls a ship or airplane.

words.s: They would capture as many people as possible.
words.sz: 他們會盡可能地抓更多的人。
words.d: To capture something is to catch and hold it.

words.s: I learned to drive a car and got a driver's license when I was eighteen.
words.sz: 我十八歲時，學了開車、考到了駕照。

words.s: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
words.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。
words.d: A card is a small piece of plastic or paper used to buy or use things.

words.sz: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。

words.sz: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

words.d: A cartoon is a funny drawing.

t: 事例，事实，事情；病例；案件

words.sz: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

words.sz: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

words.s: Better be the head of a cat than the tail of a lion.
words.sz: 寧為貓頭不為獅尾。

words.sz: 汤姆及时赶到了车站搭上了他想搭的那列车。
words.d: To catch is to grab or get something.

words.sz: 交通事故是美国青少年死亡的主要原因。

words.s: There's a big fly on the ceiling.
words.sz: 有一隻大蒼蠅在天花板上。
words.d: The ceiling is the top of a room.

words.s: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
words.sz: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。
words.d: To celebrate is to do something to show that an event is special.

t: n. 庆典，庆祝会；庆祝；颂扬

words.sz: 你现在是名人了。

words.sz: "你有看到我的手機嗎?""它在桌子上。"

words.sz: 這些紙板盒是百分之百可回收的。

words.sz: 不好意思，請問到中央公園要怎麼走?

words.sz: 伊斯蘭教大約在七世纪中傳到中國。
words.d: A century is one hundred years.

words.s: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
words.sz: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。
words.d: A ceremony is an event that happens on special occasions.

t: 确定的，肯定的；某，某些；轻微的，一点，一些
words.s: I'm certain that Tom is the only one who won't do that.
words.sz: 我确信汤姆是唯一不会那么做的人。
words.d: If you are certain about something, you know it is true.

t: adv. 当然；行（用于回答）；必定

words.sz: 你已經辛苦地工作好幾個月了,當然可以休假。

words.sz: 这个椅子坐着真舒服。

words.s: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.
words.sz: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。

t: 向...挑战；对...质疑；需要，要求；考验某人的能力

words.sz: 我們接受你們的挑戰。

t: 可能性；机会；偶然性，运气；碰巧，偶然发生
words.s: Tom thought that he had a chance to make a lot of money on the stock market.
words.sz: 汤姆觉得他有机会在股市赚一大笔钱。
words.d: A chance is an opportunity to do something.

t: 改变，变化；零钱，找头；交换，兑换

words.sz: 即使太阳从西边出来，我也不会改变主意。

t: 海峡，水道；频道，波段；路线，途径
words.s: The river cut a channel through the rocks.
words.d: A channel is a long, deep space between two edges.

words.s: We'll deal with this problem in Chapter 3.
words.sz: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。
words.d: A chapter is a part of a book that usually has a number or a title.

t: 性质，特性；品质，性格；人物，角色；符号
words.s: Who's your favorite character in this book?
words.sz: 你最喜歡這本書中的哪個角色？
words.d: Your character is your personality.

t: 特征，特性；特有的，独特的
words.s: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.
words.sz: 我凭韧性克服了困难。
words.d: A characteristic is something that shows what a person or a thing is like.

t: 控告，指控；充电；负荷，电荷；价钱，费用

words.sz: 这附近有没有可以给手机充电的地方？
words.d: A charge is the price to pay for something.

words.s: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
words.sz: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。
words.d: Charity is an act of giving help, usually money, to those who need it.

words.d: A chart is a list of information.

t: 便宜的；小气的；不值钱的

words.sz: 餐廳的飯很便宜，而且很好吃。

words.s: It is wrong to cheat at cards.
words.sz: 玩牌作弊是錯誤的。
words.d: To cheat is to be dishonest in order to win or do well.

words.sz: 你把購物單上的全都檢查過了嗎？

words.sz: 媽媽為我們做了乳酪三明治當午餐。

words.sz: 我在大學主修化學。

words.s: Tom had a pain in his chest, so he went to the hospital.
words.sz: 汤姆胸痛，所以去了医院。
words.d: The chest is the front part of a body between the neck and stomach.

words.sz: 这孩子有水痘的症状。
words.d: Chicken is a bird that is often used for food.

words.sz: 我認識了這位行政長官。

words.sz: 我認為，孩子氣的人就應該當成孩子對待。

words.s: When I heard that song, it reminded me of my childhood.
words.sz: 我一聽到那首歌，就想起來我小的時候。

words.sz: 那塊巧克力裡面有堅果嗎？

words.sz: 因為暴風雨的關係，所以我們必須待在家裡。

words.sz: 你可以選擇任何你喜歡的書。

words.sz: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

words.sz: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

words.sz: Tom是想着去安慰Mary的。

words.sz: 大房子不一定适合住。

words.sz: 雖然她在日本被撫養長大，但是她精通英語。

words.d: A community is a group of people who share the same area or interests.

words.sz: 该公司于1990年挂牌上市。
words.d: A company is a business or organization that makes or sells goods or services.

words.s: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: To compare means to say how two things are the same and different.

words.s: In comparison with Tokyo, London is small.
words.sz: 和东京比，伦敦很小。

words.s: I participated in a photography competition.
words.sz: 我參加了一個攝影比賽。

words.s: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
words.sz: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。

words.s: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.
words.sz: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。
words.d: When you complain, you say that you are unhappy about something.

words.s: There is no cause for complaint.
words.sz: 没有理由抱怨。
words.d: A complaint is an expression of unhappiness about something.

t: 完成，结束；完全的，完整的；完成的，完结的
words.s: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.
words.sz: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。

words.s: The leaves of the trees in the garden have turned completely red.
words.sz: 花园里树上的叶子已经完全变红了。
words.d: Something completely different is very, very different from before.

t: 由许多部分组成的， 复合的； 复杂的， 难懂的
综合体， 集合体； 情结， 夸大的情绪反应
words.s: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?
words.sz: 你对复合碳水化合物有什么了解吗？
words.d: If something is complex, it has many small parts. It is hard to understand.

words.s: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
words.sz: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。

t: 组成的，整体中的一部分；组成部分，成分，部件
words.s: Computers have many different components, so they are complicated to build.
words.d: A component is a part of a larger machine.

t: 计算机；电脑；电子计算机
words.s: It is becoming important for us to know how to use a computer.
words.sz: 知道如何使用电脑对我们来说变得很重要。

words.s: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
words.sz: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。
words.d: To concentrate is to give one’s full attention to something.

t: 浓度；集中；浓缩；专心；集合

words.s: I understand the concept.
words.sz: 我明白这概念。
words.d: A concept is an idea about something.

t: 关心，挂念；涉及，关系到；关心，挂念
words.s: Your problems don't concern me.
words.sz: 你的问题和我没有关系。
words.d: Concern is a feeling of worry.

words.s: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.
words.sz: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。

t: 音乐会用的；在音乐会上演出的
words.s: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
words.sz: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？
words.d: A concert is an event where you listen to people play music.

t: 结束，终止；断定，下结论；缔结；议定
words.s: I saw crumbs on my dog’s face, so I concluded that he ate my cookie.
words.d: To conclude is to arrive at a logical end by looking at evidence.

t: 结束，终结；结论，推论；缔结，签订
words.s: Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.
words.sz: 汤姆得出无论他做什么，玛丽都不会喜欢的结论。
words.d: The conclusion of something is the final part of it.

words.s: We will only consent on that condition.
words.sz: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。
words.d: The condition of someone or something is the state that they are in.

words.s: One must be responsible for one's conduct.
words.sz: 人要为自己的行为负责。
words.d: Conduct is the way that someone acts.

words.s: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
words.sz: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。

t: 信任，信心；私下里说的话
words.s: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
words.sz: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
words.d: Confidence is a feeling of certainty or ability.

words.s: I'm fairly confident that I can do that.
words.sz: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。
words.d: Confident people believe that they can do something without failing.

t: 加强，巩固；证实，肯定；批准，确认
words.s: I can neither confirm nor deny that.
words.sz: 我既不能確認也不能否定。
words.d: To confirm is to make sure something is correct.

words.s: He doesn't seem to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
words.sz: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。
words.d: A conflict is a fight between different people or groups.

words.s: Don't confuse desire with love.
words.sz: 不要把欲望和爱情混为一谈。
words.d: To confuse someone means to make them feel like they are unsure.

t: adj. 困惑的；混乱的；糊涂的
words.s: That was the part that Tom and I were most confused about.
words.sz: 这是我和汤姆最困惑的部分。

t: v.使迷惑；使混乱不清；使困窘（confuse的ing形式）adj.混乱的；混淆的；令人困惑的

words.s: Do you feel like you can't connect with other people?
words.sz: 您觉得您无法与他人交流吗？
words.d: To connect two things means to join them together.

words.s: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
words.sz: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

t: 神志清醒的，有...意识的；意识到的，自觉的
words.s: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
words.sz: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。
words.d: If someone is conscious of something, then they are aware of it.

words.s: As a consequence of missing my bus, I had to find another way to work.
words.d: A consequence is a result of a choice or action.

words.s: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.
words.sz: 总体上说，日本人很保守。

t: 考虑，细想；认为，把...看做；体贴，关心
words.s: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
words.sz: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。
words.d: To consider something means to think about it.

t: n. 考虑；原因；关心；报酬
words.s: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
words.sz: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

t: 组成，构成；在于，存在于；一致，符合
words.s: Today’s choices for lunch consisted of pizza, hamburgers, and hot dogs.
words.d: To consist of certain is to be made of parts or things them.

t: 前后一致的，始终如一的；相符的，不矛盾的
words.s: Sara comes in every day and is our most consistent worker.
words.d: If a person is consistent, they always have the same behavior or attitude.

words.s: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
words.sz: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。
words.d: When an event or action is constant, it happens a lot or all of the time.

words.s: He is constantly finding fault with other people.
words.sz: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
words.d: Constantly means doing something on a continuous basis.

words.s: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.
words.sz: 讀完他的書後，我覺得我可以構建一棟房子。
words.d: To construct something means to make or build it.

words.s: A new school building is under construction.
words.sz: 一座新的教学楼正在建设。

words.s: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.
words.sz: 瑞士人消耗不少啤酒。
words.d: To consume something means to eat or drink it.

words.s: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.
words.sz: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。
words.d: To contact people is to speak or write to them.

t: 包含；控制；容纳；牵制（敌军）
words.s: There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.
words.sz: 自來水有可能含有氯、鉛等有害物質。
words.d: To contain is to hold or have something.

t: 同时代的，同时发生的；现代的，当代的；同代人，（几乎）同年龄的人
words.s: He studies contemporary literature.
words.sz: 他学习现代文学。
words.d: When something is contemporary, it is related to the present time.

words.s: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
words.sz: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。
words.d: To be content is to be happy and not want more.

words.s: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
words.sz: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。
words.d: A contest is a game or a race.

t: 上下文，语境；（事件发生的）环境，背景
words.s: It depends on the context.
words.sz: 这要看情况。
words.d: Context is the situations that form the background of an event.

words.s: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
words.sz: 哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。
words.d: A continent is one of the seven large areas of land on the Earth.

t: 连续，继续；持续，不断发生
words.s: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.
words.sz: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请务必注意食物中毒。

words.s: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
words.sz: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。
words.d: A contract is a written agreement between two people.

words.s: The contrast between my parents is very noticeable.
words.d: A contrast is a sharp difference between two things.

words.s: We decided to contribute money to the new hospital.
words.d: To contribute to something means to do something to make it successful.

words.s: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.
words.sz: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。
words.d: To control something is to make it do what you want.

t: 方便的；[废语]适当的；[口语]近便的；实用的
words.s: I think you will find it convenient to put a short-cut on the desktop.
words.sz: 我想你迟早会知道在桌面建立一个快捷方式是有多方便。
words.d: When something is convenient, it saves you time or effort.

t: n. 交谈，会话；社交；交往，交际；会谈；（人与计算机的）人机对话
words.s: They fell into the conversation immediately.
words.sz: 他们很快就聊起来了。

t: 转变， 转化； 改变
words.s: The man converted his messy field into a garden of flowers.
words.d: To convert something means to change it into something else.

words.s: She was asked to convince him to get his son or someone else to paint the house.
words.sz: 她被要求去说服他以让他或者他的儿子或者是别的人来粉刷屋子。
words.d: To convince someone means to make that person sure of something.

words.s: Tom was convinced that the food he had just eaten had been poisoned.
words.sz: 湯姆相信有人在他剛剛吃的食物裡下了毒。

words.s: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
words.sz: 一個差勁的廚師和下毒者唯一的不同在於他們的意圖。

t: 炊具；烹饪用水果；窜改者

words.sz: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。
words.d: Cooking food involves making it ready to eat.

words.s: I was quite thirsty and wanted to drink something cool.
words.sz: 我很渴，想喝点冷饮。

words.s: I keep the master copy under lock and key.
words.sz: 我妥善保管原版拷貝。

t: 果实的心； 核心， 要点

words.d: A core is the main or central part of something.

t: 角落，拐角处；地区，偏僻处；困境，窘境
words.s: As we went around the corner, the lake came into view.
words.sz: 当我们走到转角处，湖就映入了眼帘。

t: 公司的，社团的；全体的，共同的
words.s: Tom enjoys working in the corporate world.
words.d: If something is corporate, it is related to a large business.

words.s: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
words.sz: 我正在尋找可以幫我修改這篇論文的母語人士。

t: 花费；使付出；使花许多钱

words.sz: 把我的電視機修好花了我一萬日元。
words.d: To cost is to require payment.

words.s: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
words.sz: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。
words.d: A cottage is a small, old house in the countryside.

words.s: Someday I'll buy a cotton candy machine.
words.sz: 有一天我买了一台棉花糖机。
words.d: Cotton is a cloth made from the fibers of the cotton plant.

words.s: Tom asked me if I knew anybody who could translate from French into English.
words.sz: 湯姆問我是否認識可以做法英翻譯的人。

words.s: You should run for city council.
words.sz: 你应该去竞选城市委员会。
words.d: A council is a group of people who run a city or town.

words.sz: 汤姆闭上了眼睛开始数羊。

words.s: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
words.sz: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。

words.sz: 乡间有很多树。

words.d: A county is the largest division of a state in a country.

words.sz: 一些航班由於地震被延誤了。
words.d: A couple is made of two things that go together.

words.sz: 汤姆告诉玛丽他想要自杀，但他没有那么做的勇气。

t: 科目；课程；过程；进程；道路；路线，航向；一道菜
words.s: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.
words.sz: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。

words.sz: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

words.sz: 他不是我的兄弟。他是我的表弟。

words.sz: 我不喜欢做那个总是挤牛奶的人。

words.s: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.
words.sz: 他的妻子在醫院裡因為她在一場車禍中受傷了。

words.s: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
words.sz: 你是怎麼想到這麼瘋狂的主意的？

t: 奶油，乳脂；精华；面霜；乳酪
words.s: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll give you a kiss.
words.sz: 如果你買給我冰淇淋，我就親你一下。

words.s: She created an igloo from blocks of snow.
words.d: To create means to make something new.

t: 创造， 创建； 创造的作品， 产物； 宇宙， 天地万物 (n.)

words.d: A creation is something original that is made.

t: 有创造力的，创造性的，创作的

words.sz: 汤姆说他是习惯的产物。
words.d: A creature is an animal or person.

t: 信任，可信性；赞扬，荣誉，功劳；信用，信贷；赊购

words.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。

words.sz: 現代船隻只需要一小組的船員。
words.d: A crew is a group of workers.

t: 罪行，犯罪；罪恶；犯罪活动
words.s: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
words.sz: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。
words.d: If someone commits a crime, he or she does something bad that can be punished by law.

words.s: His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.
words.sz: 他儿子的犯罪行为给他带来了很大的痛苦。

words.sz: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。

t: （批评判断的）标准；准则；规范；准据

words.sz: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

words.sz: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。
words.d: Criticism is the act of saying that something is not correct or good.

t: vt. 批评；吹毛求疵；非难
vi. 批评；吹毛求疵；非难

words.s: I had a good crop of onions this year.
words.d: A crop is something produced by the land.

t: 交叉，十字；十字架，十字形物
交叉的，相反的；乖戾的；生气的
words.s: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
words.sz: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。

t: 群众,一伙;一堆,许多,大众

words.sz: 我聽到車站外的人群中有人在叫我的名字。
words.d: A crowd is a large group of people who are together in one place.

words.s: The train was so crowded that I had to keep standing all the way.
words.sz: 這班火車如此的擁擠以至於我整個車程都必須站著。

words.s: This is a crucial point.
words.sz: 这是一个关键点。

t: 残酷的，残忍的；使人痛苦的，让人受难的；无情的，严酷的

words.sz: 可憐的人民任憑殘暴的獨裁者處置。

words.s: The moment I held the baby in my arms, it began to cry.
words.sz: 我一把孩子抱在手里，他就开始哭了。

words.s: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
words.sz: 一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。

words.s: The students are talking about language and culture.
words.sz: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。
words.d: Culture is the music, art, and writings of a certain place or group of people.

words.s: Tom went into the kitchen and poured himself a cup of coffee.
words.sz: 汤姆进了厨房，给自己倒了杯咖啡。

t: 柜橱； 碗碟橱， 食橱
words.s: She folded up the towels and put them away in the cupboard.
words.sz: 她把毛巾折叠好再放入柜子里。
words.d: A cupboard is a piece of furniture that is used to store food or household items.

t: 治疗；治愈；使硫化；加工处理

words.sz: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。
words.d: A cure is a medical treatment to make a sickness go away.

words.s: The currency in China is different from that in Australia.
words.d: The currency of a country is the type of money used in that country.

t: 电流；潮流，趋势；当前的，现在的；通用的，流行的，被普遍接受的
words.s: An electric current can generate magnetism.
words.sz: 電流可以產生磁性。
words.d: A current is a steady and constant flow of air or water in a river or ocean.

words.s: We are currently looking for individuals who have experience in customer service.
words.sz: 我們目前正在尋找具有客服工作經驗的人員。

words.sz: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。
words.d: A curtain is a cloth hung over a window or used to divide a room.
