words.s: The road curves to the left and to the right.
words.d: To curve is to move in a line that bends and does not go straight.

t: n. 习惯，惯例；风俗；海关，关税；经常光顾；（经常性的）顾客
words.s: It is a custom that the bride and groom have the first dance.
words.d: A custom is a way of doing things that has been the same for a long time.

words.s: I had to wait 20 minutes on the phone before reaching the customer service rep.
words.sz: 我不得不在電話裡等了20分鐘才聯繫到客服代表。
words.d: A customer is a person who buys something at a store.

words.s: He cut it with the knife that he received as a present from his brother.
words.sz: 他用哥哥送給他的刀子切開了。

t: 循环；周期；自行车；整套；一段时间
words.s: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
words.sz: 我通常骑自行车或乘公交车去上班。
words.d: A cycle is a series of events that go in a circle from the end back to the beginning again.

words.s: You should apologize to Dad for not coming home in time for supper.
words.sz: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。

words.s: Most people write about their daily life.
words.sz: 大部分人写的东西是关于他们的日常生活的。

words.s: Our employees are working around the clock to fix the damage caused by the ice storm.
words.sz: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。
words.d: To damage something is to break it.

words.s: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
words.sz: Tom没有意图去邀请Mary去即将来临的舞会。

words.s: My girlfriend is a good dancer.
words.sz: 我的女朋友跳舞跳得很棒。

words.s: I need to find somewhere to practice dancing.
words.sz: 我需要找個地方練舞。

words.s: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.
words.sz: 红旗代表存在危险。
words.d: Danger is the possibility that someone or something will be harmed, destroyed, or killed.

words.s: I told Tom it would be dangerous to do that, but he still wanted to do it.
words.sz: 我和汤姆说过那样做很危险，但他还是想那样做。

t: 黑暗的，深色的；模糊的；无知的；忧郁的
words.s: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
words.sz: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。

words.s: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
words.sz: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。
words.d: Data is a collection of information and facts.

words.s: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
words.sz: 這起空難是迄今為止加拿大境內最嚴重的空難。

words.s: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
words.sz: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

words.s: The post office is closed on Christmas day and mail will not be delivered.
words.sz: 聖誕節當天郵局休息，郵件將不予投遞。
words.d: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, beginning at midnight.

t: 无生命的；呆板的；废弃了的
words.s: If there was no sun, all the animals would be dead.
words.sz: 如果没有太阳，那所有生物都会死。

t: 处理，给予；做买卖，经营；协议，交易
words.s: If you want to go, then go. If you don't want to, then it's no big deal.
words.sz: 如果你想去，就去好了。如果你不想去，那也没什么大不了的。
words.d: A deal is an agreement that you have with another person.

words.s: Dear Santa, I want a girlfriend for Christmas.
words.sz: 圣诞老人，我想要一个女朋友当圣诞礼物。

words.s: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.
words.sz: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。

words.s: She celebrated her three decades of work with the company.
words.d: A decade is a period of ten years.

words.s: The Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.
words.sz: 日本人在一九四一年十二月七日襲擊珍珠港。
words.d: December is the twelfth month of the year.

t: 正派的；得体的；相当好的
words.s: Tom is a decent sort of guy.
words.sz: 湯姆是箇誠實的孩子。
words.d: A decent person or thing is OK or good enough.

words.s: Now's the time to decide whether you really want to get married or not.
words.sz: 现在是你决定是不是真要结婚的时候。
words.d: To decide is to make a definite choice.

words.s: His decision to retire surprised all of us.
words.sz: 他要退休的決定讓我們都感到吃驚。

words.s: Do you have anything to declare?
words.sz: 你有任何要申報的東西嗎？
words.d: To declare is to say something officially.

t: 下降，减少；衰退，衰落；倾斜
words.s: I must decline.
words.sz: 我必须拒绝。
words.d: To decline an offer or invitation means to say no to it.

words.s: Many people decorate their homes for Christmas.
words.sz: 許多人都會在聖誕節期間裝飾自己的家。
words.d: When you decorate a room, you make it more attractive by adding beautiful things to it.

words.s: This medicine will decrease your pain.
words.sz: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
words.d: To decrease something is to make it less than it was before.

words.s: The baby was in a deep sleep in his mother's arms.
words.sz: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。

words.s: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
words.sz: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

words.s: The champion defeated the challenger in the boxing match.
words.d: To defeat someone is to beat that person in a game or battle.

t: 防御，防卫，保卫；为...辩护，为...答辩
规定，限定；使明确，使清楚；解释，下定义
words.s: People define success in many different ways.
words.d: To define means to clearly state, show, or explain what something is.

words.s: I cannot give you a definite answer today.
words.sz: 我今天无法给您一个最终的答复。
words.d: A definite thing is certain or sure to be true.

words.s: Tom says that Mary definitely won't accept the job.
words.sz: 湯姆說瑪麗絕不會接受這工作。

words.s: He got a master's degree in law.
words.sz: 他得到了法律碩士學位。
words.d: Degree is a unit for measuring temperature.

words.s: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
words.sz: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。
words.d: To delay means to wait to do something.

t: 故意的， 蓄意的； 慎重的， 深思熟虑的
words.s: Bernie made a deliberate attempt to injure Andy.
words.d: A deliberate action is one done on purpose, not by accident.

t: adv. 故意地；谨慎地；慎重地
美味的； 芬芳的， 怡人的； 有趣的
words.s: That place's food is delicious and their prices are low. However, their location isn't good.
words.sz: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。
words.d: If a food is delicious, it is tasty.

words.s: He felt such delight after getting a promotion at work.
words.d: Delight is a feeling of being very happy with something.

words.s: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
words.sz: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。

t: 投递，传送；发表，宣布；给予；发射
words.s: Please deliver it to this address.
words.sz: 你能把它送到這個地址嗎？
words.d: To deliver something is to take it from one place to another.

words.s: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
words.sz: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。

t: 论证，证明；示范，宣传；游行，示威
words.s: Can you demonstrate it?
words.sz: 您可以示範一下嗎?
words.d: To demonstrate something is to show how it is done.

words.s: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
words.sz: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

words.s: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.
words.sz: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。

words.s: First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
words.sz: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百貨公司的特價活動。

words.s: With the weather getting worse, the departure was put off.
words.sz: 由于天气变差，出发延迟了。
words.d: A departure is the act of leaving a place.

words.s: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
words.sz: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
words.d: To depend on something is to need it for support or help.

words.s: She sometimes gets depressed.
words.sz: 她偶爾有憂鬱的心情。

t: adj. 压抑的；使人沮丧的
words.s: It was truly depressing.
words.sz: 真的令人丧气。

words.s: We measured the depth of the river.
words.sz: 我们测量了这条河的深度。

words.s: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
words.sz: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
words.d: To describe is to say or write what someone or something is like.

words.s: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
words.sz: 你看過富士山嗎?它美得無法形容。
words.d: A description of someone or something says what they are like.

words.s: The Sahara is a vast desert.
words.sz: 撒哈拉沙漠广袤无垠。
words.d: The desert is an area of land without many plants or water.

words.s: You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.
words.sz: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。
words.d: To deserve is to be worthy of something as a result of one’s actions.

words.s: This design is very ergonomic.
words.sz: 這個設計很人性化。

t: adj. 由设计师专门设计的；享有盛名的；赶时髦的
words.s: She hopes to become a designer.
words.sz: 她希望成為一名設計師。

t: 希望，渴望；愿望，欲望，要求
words.s: There are no people who don't desire peace.
words.sz: 沒人不渴望和平。
words.d: To desire is to want something.

words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。
words.d: A desk is a piece of furniture that people sit at to do work.

words.s: I'm in a desperate situation.
words.sz: 我處在絕境。
words.d: A desperate person will try anything to do or change something.

words.s: Despite his riches, he's not contented.
words.sz: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
words.d: Despite shows a difference from what is expected.

words.s: They made straight for their destination.
words.sz: 他們直奔目的地。
words.d: A destination is the place where someone or something is going.

words.s: Destroy this temple.
words.sz: 摧毁这个寺庙。
words.d: To destroy means to damage something so badly that it cannot be used.

words.s: He described the incident in detail.
words.sz: 他詳細地描述了事故狀況。
words.d: A detail is a small piece of information.

t: adj. 详细的，精细的；复杂的，详尽的
v. 详细说明（detail的过去分词）
words.s: I want more detailed information.
words.sz: 我要更多詳細的訊息。

t: 查明，测出，发现，察觉；当场发现某人在干坏事
words.s: The boy ran to the kitchen when he detected the smell of cookies.
words.d: To detect means to notice or find something.

words.s: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
words.sz: 她僱了一個私人偵探看守她的丈夫。

words.s: When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.
words.sz: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。

t: 下定决心的, 毅然的, 坚决的
words.s: She's determined to become a secretary.
words.sz: 她下决心要成为秘书。

words.s: Our country must develop its natural resources.
words.sz: 我們國家必須開發自然資源。
words.d: To develop is to make something larger or more advanced.

t: 发展；开发；发育；住宅小区（专指由同一开发商开发的）；[摄] 显影
words.s: The ecological footprint of a country is closely related to its level of economic development.
words.sz: 生態印跡與一國的經濟發展程度密切相關。

words.s: You should have shown him the device.
words.sz: 你应该给他看看这装置。
words.d: A device is an object or a machine.

words.s: By following the diagram, I was able to put the desk together.
words.d: A diagram is a simple drawing that explains what something is or how it works.

t: n. 钻石，金刚石；菱形；方块牌
words.s: This might not be a genuine diamond.
words.sz: 這可能不是真的鑽石。

words.s: She has kept a diary for 3 years.
words.sz: 她已經寫了三年的日記。
words.d: A diary is a book in which people write their personal experiences.

words.s: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
words.sz: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。
words.d: A dictionary is a book that tells you what words mean.

words.s: "The good die young" is an old saying which may or may not be true.
words.sz: “好人不长命”是句或真或假的老话。

words.s: We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a diet.
words.sz: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。
words.d: A diet is the food regularly eaten by a person.

words.s: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
words.sz: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
words.d: A difference is a way that something is not like other things.

t: 不同的；个别的，与众不同的
words.s: When she was in Los Angeles, she had at least six different jobs.
words.sz: 當她在洛杉磯的時候,她至少有六份工作。
words.d: Different describes someone or something that is not the same as others.

words.s: A person views things differently according to whether they are rich or poor.
words.sz: 每一個人對事情的看法不同是依據他們是富有還是貧窮。

t: 困难的；不随和的；执拗的
words.s: At first, he thought English very difficult, but now he thinks it is easy.
words.sz: 起初他以为英语很难，如今他觉得很简单。

words.s: I think you'll have very little difficulty in getting a driver's license.
words.sz: 我想您要拿到驾照根本不难。

words.s: In 1848, people came to California to dig for gold.
words.sz: 1848年人们来加利福尼亚淘金。
words.d: To dig is to make a hole in the ground.

words.s: My cell phone has a built-in digital camera.
words.sz: 我的手機有內建的數位相機。
words.d: When something is digital, it is characterized by computer technology.

words.s: You should apologize to your father for not getting home in time for dinner.
words.sz: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。
words.d: Dinner is the main meal eaten in the evening.

t: 直接的；直系的；亲身的；恰好的
直接地；正好；按直系关系
words.s: Are there any direct flights between Boston and Sydney?
words.sz: 请问波士顿和悉尼之间有直飞航班吗？
words.d: If something is direct, it goes straight between two places.

t: 方向；指导；趋势；用法说明
words.s: You have a really good sense of direction.
words.sz: 你的方向感很好。
words.d: A direction is the way to go.

t: 直接地； 正好地， 截然； 立即
words.s: I got the information from him directly.
words.sz: 我直接從他那裡得到訊息。

t: 主任，主管；导演；人事助理
words.s: They appointed him as a director.
words.sz: 他们任命他为经理。

t: 污垢，泥土；灰尘，尘土；下流话
words.s: The children were playing in the dirt.
words.sz: 孩子们在尘土里游戏。

t: 下流的，卑鄙的；肮脏的；恶劣的；暗淡的
words.s: Don't touch this with your dirty hands.
words.sz: 别用你的脏手碰这个。

t: n. 缺点；不利条件；损失
words.s: Mike had a disadvantage in the race since he hurt his knee.
words.d: A disadvantage is a situation that makes it hard to do something.

t: vi. 意见不一致，持不同意见
words.s: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
words.sz: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。
words.d: To disagree with someone means to have a different opinion from them.

words.s: The top of the building is disappearing in the clouds.
words.d: To disappear means to go away or not be seen.

t: adj. 失望的，沮丧的；受挫折的
words.s: He was disappointed that things didn't turn out as he'd hoped.
words.sz: 事情没能如他所愿让他感到失望。

t: adj.令人失望的；令人扫兴的v.令人失望（disappoint的ing形式）；辜负…的期望

words.s: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
words.sz: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。
words.d: A disaster is a really bad thing that happens.

words.s: She gave me this compact disc.
words.sz: 她給了我這個光碟。

t: 纪律、训练、自制力；训练方法；行为准则；学科，专业，科目
words.s: One of the teacher’s jobs is to teach her students discipline.
words.d: Discipline is training that helps people follow the rules.

words.s: For quantities of 20 or more, we can allow you a special discount of 10% on the prices quoted.
words.sz: 20个以上九折特惠。

words.s: Call me if you discover anything.
words.sz: 如果你發現什麼，請打給我。
words.d: To discover something is to find it for the first time.

words.s: That discovery was quite accidental.
words.sz: 那个发现纯属偶然。

words.s: There's something I've been meaning to discuss with you.
words.sz: 有件事我一直想跟你商量。
words.d: To discuss is to talk about something with another person.

words.s: They came up with a plan after a long discussion.
words.sz: 他们终于在漫长的讨论之后得出了一个计划。

words.s: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
words.sz: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。
words.d: A disease is an illness that causes specific problems.

t: 盘；餐具；一盘食物；外貌有吸引力的人
盛于碟盘中；分发；使某人的希望破灭；说（某人）的闲话
words.s: I'd like to have this meat dish with your best white wine.
words.sz: 我想喝著你最好的白酒吃這肉。
words.d: A dish is a type of food that is cooked in a particular way.

words.s: I'm starting to dislike her.
words.sz: 我开始不喜欢她了。

words.s: He quickly dismissed my idea about the new project.
words.d: To dismiss something is to say it is not important.

words.s: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
words.sz: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。
words.d: To display something is to show it, especially by putting it in a certain place.

words.s: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
words.sz: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。
words.d: A distance is how far it is between two points.

words.s: The teacher distributed crayons and markers to her students.
words.d: To distribute something is to give it to a number of people.

words.s: The typhoon struck the Kanto district.
words.sz: 台风袭击了关东地区。
words.d: A district is a small part of a city, county, state, or country.

t: 划分，分裂；分配；分开，隔开
words.s: Let's divide this money between you and me.
words.sz: 这钱你和我分了吧。
words.d: To divide something is to split it into smaller parts.

t: 分开，分配；部门；差异，分歧；除法
words.s: The children haven't studied division yet.
words.sz: 孩子們還沒上過除法。

words.s: It's a pity they're getting divorced.
words.sz: 很遗憾他们离婚了。

words.s: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
words.sz: 現在我們什麼也做不了，救不了湯姆。我們唯一能做的就是祈禱。

t: 修理；篡改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位
words.s: The doctor told Mary that she couldn't have any more children.
words.sz: 医生告诉玛丽她不能再要更多孩子了。
words.d: A doctor is a person who studies medicine and helps sick people.

words.s: This document was actually written by Tom.
words.sz: 這文件其實是湯姆寫的。
words.d: A document is a written text, usually not in the form of a book.

t: 纪录片；文献的，文件的；记录的，纪实的
狗；丑女人；卑鄙的人；(俚)朋友
words.s: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
words.sz: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。
words.d: A dog is an animal with four legs and a tail that is kept as a pet or trained to work.

words.s: This little baby tore up a 10 dollar bill.
words.sz: 這個小嬰孩撕掉了一張十美元的鈔票。

t: 家庭的；家用的，家务的；国内的，本国的
words.s: The airline has fifty domestic flights daily.
words.d: Domestic refers to something that happens within a particular country.

t: 支配，统治；比...高；俯视；在...中占重要地位
words.s: The loud man dominated the conversation.
words.d: To dominate someone or something is to control them.

words.s: How much money do you donate every year?
words.sz: 你每年捐多少钱？
words.d: To donate is to give something to a charity or organization.

words.s: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
words.sz: 最合逻輯的放鞋處是門口附近。
words.d: A door is an object that swings or slides open and shut.

t: 双的，双倍的；使加倍，翻一番
words.s: Prices are double what they were ten years ago.
words.sz: 价钱是10年前的2倍。

words.d: An event is something that happens, especially something important.

words.s: Everything will blow over eventually.
words.sz: 一切最終都會過去。
words.d: When something happens at a later time or in the end, it happens eventually.

t: (Ever)人名；(英)埃弗；(俄)叶韦尔；(西、法)埃韦尔
words.s: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
words.sz: 你看過富士山嗎?它美得無法形容。
words.d: Ever means at any time.

words.s: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
words.sz: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。

words.s: Everybody talks about the weather, but nobody does anything about it.
words.sz: 每個人都在談論天氣,但是沒有人為它做任何事情。

words.s: TV plays an important part in everyday life.
words.sz: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。

words.s: Everyone held their breath to see who would win the presidential election.
words.sz: 所有人都屏住呼吸关注着谁会赢得总统竞选。

t: 每件事物；最重要的东西；（有关的）一切；万事
words.s: I think I understood everything Tom said, but I'm not absolutely sure.
words.sz: 我认为我听懂了汤姆说的所有话，但我不确定。

words.s: I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my book.
words.sz: 我什麼地方都找過了,但卻找不到我的書。

words.s: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
words.sz: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。
words.d: Evidence is a fact or thing that you use to prove something.

t: 邪恶的，罪恶的；邪恶，罪恶
words.s: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
words.sz: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。
words.d: Evil describes something or someone bad or cruel, not good.

words.s: Can you explain the exact meaning of this word?
words.sz: 你能否說出這個詞的精確意思?
words.d: Exact means correct in every detail.

t: 确切地，精确地；确实如此
words.s: Tom didn't know exactly what it was that Mary wanted him to do.
words.sz: 汤姆不知道玛丽到底让他做什么。

words.s: The date of the festival coincides with that of the exam.
words.sz: 节日和考试碰巧在同一天。
words.d: An exam is a test.

words.s: You should have known better than to take an examination without preparing for it.
words.sz: 你應該知道要為考試作準備。

words.s: Dentists take X-rays to examine your teeth.
words.sz: 牙医用X光检查你的牙齿。
words.d: To examine something is to look at it carefully.

t: 作为…的例子；为…做出榜样
words.s: You should set a good example for your children.
words.sz: 你应该给你的孩子们树立好榜样。
words.d: An example of something is a thing that is typical of it.

words.s: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
words.sz: 他是一位優秀的科學家，更是一位偉大的詩人。
words.d: When something is excellent, it is very good.

words.s: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.
words.sz: 除了那些我们尝试过的政府形态，民主是最差的那种了。

t: 交换，调换，兑换；交易，交流
words.s: The company went public and became listed on the stock exchange in 1990.
words.sz: 该公司于1990年挂牌上市。
words.d: To exchange is to give one thing in return for another.

words.s: Tom was excited to go to the concert.
words.sz: 汤姆为去音乐会而激动。

words.s: What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?
words.sz: 你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？

words.s: Excuse me, but could you tell me how to get to Central Park?
words.sz: 不好意思，請問到中央公園要怎麼走?

t: 实行的，执行的，行政的；总经理，董事，高管，行政负责人
words.s: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
words.sz: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。
words.d: An executive is the top manager of a business.

t: 运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼
锻炼；练习；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐
words.s: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
words.sz: 最好的減肥方法就是少吃多運動。
words.d: To exercise is to run or play sports so that you can be healthy.

words.s: Did you go to the art exhibition?
words.sz: 你去看藝術展覽了嗎？

t: 存在，实际上有；（尤指在困境或贫困中）生活，生存
words.s: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
words.sz: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。
words.d: To exist is to be real.

t: 存在，生存，（尤指艰难或无聊的）生活方式
words.s: Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?
words.sz: 你相信有幽灵吗？

words.s: A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.
words.d: To expand is to become bigger in size.

words.s: We did not expect him to finish the task in so short a time.
words.sz: 我们没指望过他在那么短的时间里完成工作。
words.d: If you expect something to happen, you believe it will happen.

t: v. 预期；盼望（expect的过去分词）
words.s: The dolphin and trainer communicated much better than we expected.
words.sz: 海豚和驯养员交流得比我们所期望的好得多。

words.s: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
words.sz: 我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。
words.d: An expedition is a long trip, usually to a place very far away.

words.s: She wrote down all the expenses for her trip.
words.d: An expense is the money that people spend on something.

words.s: The show was wonderful, but the tickets were too expensive.
words.sz: 这场秀棒极了，但是门票太贵了。
words.d: Expensive things cost a lot of money.

words.s: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
words.sz: 他的智慧和經驗使他能處理這個麻煩。
words.d: To experience is to do or see something or have something happen to you.

t: 老练的，熟练的；富有经验的
words.s: Tom isn't an experienced driver.
words.sz: 汤姆不是一个经验老道的司机。

words.s: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.
words.sz: 要完成实验，三个月太短了。
words.d: An experiment is a test that you do to see what will happen.

t: 专家，能手；专门的；熟练的，有经验的
words.s: Even expert drivers can make mistakes.
words.sz: 再怎麼經驗老到的司機都會出錯。
words.d: An expert is someone who is very good at doing something.

words.s: It would take me too much time to explain to you why it's not going to work.
words.sz: 给你解释这为什么行不通要花很多时间。

words.s: The explanation is by no means satisfactory.
words.sz: 這個解釋不是很令人滿意。

words.s: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.
words.sz: 一点火花让火药爆炸。
words.d: To explode is to suddenly move apart in many smaller pieces.

t: 爆炸， 爆发， 炸裂； 激增， 扩大
words.s: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.
words.sz: 昨晚，烟花厂发生了爆炸。

words.s: The United States exports many cereals and grains.
words.d: To export products means to sell them to other countries.

words.s: He took off his shirt to expose his costume.
words.d: To expose is to make known something that is hidden.

t: 表达，表示；特快的，快速的；快车，快运
words.s: I'd like to know the phone number of the nearest American Express office.
words.sz: 我想知道最近的美國運通辦事處的電話號碼。
words.d: To express a feeling or idea means to show others how one thinks or feels.

t: 表达，表示；语句，措词；表情
words.s: That expression is archaic.
words.sz: 那種表達方式已經過時了。

t: 给予，提供；放大，扩大；延长，延伸
words.s: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.
words.sz: 我想延长这里的住宿多几天。

words.s: I agree with what you say to some extent.
words.sz: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
words.d: The extent of something is how large, important, or serious it is.

t: 外部的；表面的；[药] 外用的；外国的；外面的
words.s: Save it on the external hard drive.
words.sz: 把它保存在外接式硬碟。
words.d: When something is external, it is connected to an outer part.

t: 临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品
额外的，另外收费的；特大的
words.s: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
words.sz: 我太太兼職的工作賺進了一些額外的錢。
words.d: If something is extra, it is more than what is needed.

t: 非凡的；特别的；离奇的；临时的；特派的
words.s: Tom is an extraordinary man.
words.sz: 汤姆是个不寻常的人。
words.d: Extraordinary things are amazing.

t: 极度的，极端的；极端；最大程度
words.s: Your proposal is a bit extreme.
words.sz: 你的建議有點極端。

words.s: Declarations of variables are extremely important in C and C++.
words.sz: 变量的声明在C和C++中极其重要。
words.d: If something is extremely good, it is very, very good.

t: 眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点
words.s: You nearly poked me in the eye with your pencil.
words.sz: 你的鉛筆差點戳到我的眼睛了。

t: 脸，面貌；表情；正面，表面；面临着
words.s: Tom wouldn't dare show his face around here again.
words.sz: 汤姆不敢再到这里露面。
words.d: To face is to deal with something in a direct way.

words.s: There are many educational facilities in big cities.
words.d: A facility is a building that exists for a particular purpose.

words.s: As a matter of fact, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.
words.sz: 事實上，我從今天早上開始沒有吃任何東西。
words.d: A fact is a piece of information that is true.

words.s: Smoking is the main factor that causes lung cancer.
words.d: A factor is something that has an effect on the way another thing happens.

words.s: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
words.sz: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。
words.d: A factory is a building where things are made or put together.

t: 失败，不及格；衰退，减弱；破产
words.s: That kind of person will definitely fail.
words.sz: 这种人注定惨败。
words.d: To fail means you do not succeed in what you try to do.

words.s: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
words.sz: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。
words.d: A failure happens when something is not done right.

t: 公平的，合理的；相当的，尚好的；晴朗的；整齐的，清洁的
words.s: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
words.sz: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。
words.d: Fair means reasonable or right.

words.s: Tom seems to be a fairly successful businessman.
words.sz: 湯姆看來是箇很成功的商人。

words.s: I have absolute faith in you.
words.sz: 我百分之百相信你。
words.d: Faith is trust or belief without proof.

words.s: Manholes are round because that way they won't accidentally fall through the hole.
words.sz: 人孔是圓的，因為這樣人孔蓋就不會意外地掉進洞裡。

words.s: The truth is that nothing is totally true or false.
words.sz: 真相是沒有甚麼完全正確或錯誤。
words.d: If something is false, it is not correct.

words.s: All of you are familiar with the truth of the story.
words.sz: 你們所有的人都熟悉這個故事的真相。
words.d: People or things familiar to you are those you know well.

t: 家庭；亲属；家族；子女；[生]科；语族；[化]族
家庭的；家族的；适合于全家的
words.s: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
words.sz: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。
words.d: A family is a group of people who are related to each other.

t: 著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的
words.s: I like this picture, not just because it's famous, but because it really is a masterpiece.
words.sz: 我喜欢这幅画，不仅是因为它的名气，而是因为它真的是一个杰作。
words.d: A famous person or thing is well known.

words.s: Does any other country fan the flames of patriotism as much as America?
words.sz: 有没有一个国家比美国更提倡爱国主义？

t: 想象力；幻想，幻觉；爱好，迷恋
words.s: Tom and Mary stayed at a fancy hotel.
words.sz: 汤姆和玛丽入住了一家高档酒店。
words.d: A fancy thing is nicer or more detailed than normal.

t: 极好的， 极出色的， 了不起的； 极大的； 难以相信的； 异想天开的， 不实际的； 奇异的， 古怪的
words.s: The student did a fantastic job on his project and got an award.
words.d: A fantastic thing is really good.

words.s: Our task has been easy so far, but it will be difficult from now on.
words.sz: 我们的任务到目前为止很轻松，但从现在开始将会变得很难。
words.d: If something is far, it is not close.

words.s: I've never lived on a farm, but both of my parents grew up on farms.
words.sz: 我從沒有在農場住，但我的父母都在農場長大。

words.s: She borrowed a saw from the farmer.
words.sz: 她向農夫借了一把鋸子。

t: 迷人的；吸引人的；使人神魂颠倒的
方式，样子；流行式样，时尚，时装
words.s: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
words.sz: 你可能認為那些鞋子很時髦,但是他們不是。

words.s: It is very fashionable to wear a hat.
words.d: Something fashionable is what people like to wear and do now.

t: 快速的，迅速的；紧的，稳固的
words.s: The professor spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
words.sz: 那个教授讲得太快了，没有一个人听得懂。
words.d: To fast means to go without food or drink for a period of time.

t: 使固定；集中于；扎牢；强加于
words.s: Fasten your seat belt, please.
words.sz: 請繫好安全帶。
words.d: To fasten something is to close it or attach it to something.

t: 肥的，胖的；油腻的；丰满的
words.s: Were you fat when you were in high school?
words.sz: 你在高中的时候胖吗？
words.d: Fat is an oily solid or liquid substance in food.

t: 父亲，爸爸；神父；祖先；前辈
words.s: You should apologize to your father for not getting home in time for dinner.
words.sz: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。

t: 故障；[地质] 断层；错误；缺点；毛病；（网球等）发球失误
words.s: He is constantly finding fault with other people.
words.sz: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
words.d: A fault is responsibility for a mistake.

t: 恩惠，善意的行为；喜爱，偏爱，赞同
最喜欢的，中意的；最喜爱的人或物

words.s: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.
words.sz: 不要害怕意外，但要有準備。
words.d: Fear is the feeling of being afraid.

words.s: Down in the valley a mist like a white feather rose gently into a white cloud, and obscured everything.
words.sz: 山谷中，薄霧如白色羽毛般緩緩升騰，化作一團白雲，遮蔽了一切。
words.d: Feathers are the things covering a bird’s bodies.

words.s: It isn't a bug. It's an undocumented feature.
words.sz: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
words.d: A feature is an important part of something.

words.s: He has not written to us since last February.
words.sz: 他從去年二月開始就沒寫信給我們。

words.s: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
words.sz: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

words.s: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
words.sz: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

words.s: I asked my boss for feedback on my work.
words.d: Feedback is comments to a person about how they are doing something.

t: n. [林] 一季所伐的木材；折缝；兽皮
v. 掉下；摔倒；下垂；变坏（fall的过去式）
words.s: While I was reading in bed last night, I fell asleep with the light on.
words.sz: 我昨晚在床上看书的时候点着灯就睡了。

words.s: After a couple of drinks, the guy was feeling no pain.
words.sz: 喝了幾杯酒後，這個傢伙就感覺不痛了。

words.s: We're fellow countrymen.
words.sz: 我们是同胞。
words.d: A fellow is someone who shares a job or quality with someone else.

t: 女性的；雌性的；柔弱的，柔和的
words.s: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
words.sz: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。
words.d: Female refers to women or girls.

words.s: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
words.sz: 花园被木栅栏围了起来。

t: 节日；庆祝，纪念活动；欢乐
words.s: They helped one another to make the school festival a success.
words.sz: 他们互帮互助，把校庆搞得很成功。
words.d: A festival is an event that is held to celebrate a particular thing.

words.s: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.
words.sz: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。
words.d: A few things is a small number of them.

words.s: He's very fond of science fiction.
words.sz: 他非常喜欢科幻小说。
words.d: Fiction is a story that is not true.

t: 田，田野；运动场；领域，范围；电磁场
words.s: Field hockey is not very popular in China.
words.sz: 曲棍球在中国不是很流行。
words.d: A field is a subject that people study or an area of activity that they are involved in as part of their work.

words.s: Please be ready in fifteen minutes.
words.sz: 请在15分钟内准备好。

words.s: I'd like to do shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
words.sz: 我想在紐約的第五大道購物。

words.s: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.
words.sz: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。

t: 战斗的；好战的；适于格斗的
奋斗（fight的ing形式）；打仗；与…进行拳击
words.s: A group of young men were fighting.
words.sz: 一群年輕人在打架。
words.d: Fighting is physical conflict between people or groups in a war, in the street, etc.

t: 数字；体形；图形；人物；算出，估计，推测
words.s: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
words.sz: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

words.s: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
words.sz: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

t: 装满，使充满；满足；堵塞；任职
words.s: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.
words.sz: 确保亲自填写注册表格。

t: 在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影
words.s: There isn't any film in this camera.
words.sz: 這箇相機裡沒有膠片。

t: 最终的；决定性的；不可更改的
决赛；期末考试；当日报纸的末版
words.s: We left the final decision to him.
words.sz: 我們讓他做最後的決定。
words.d: If something is final, it is the last part.

words.s: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
words.sz: 經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。
words.d: When something finally happens, it happens at the end of a series of events.

words.s: The government financed the scientist’s experiments with new weapons.
words.d: To finance someone or something means to provide money for them.

words.s: Russia is facing great financial difficulties.
words.sz: 俄罗斯面临着严重的财政困难。

t: vt. 查找，找到；发现；认为；感到；获得
words.s: By the way, did you find the umbrella you said you'd lost the other day?
words.sz: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？

words.s: The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.
words.sz: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。

t: 好的；优良的；细小的，精美的；健康的；晴朗的
words.s: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.
words.sz: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。

words.s: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.
words.sz: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。

words.s: We probably don't have enough time to finish doing that today.
words.sz: 我们应该不够时间在今天之内完成它。

t: 火；火灾；炮火；炉火；热情；激情；磨难
点燃；解雇；开除；使发光；烧制；激动；放枪
words.s: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
words.sz: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

t: 坚固的；坚决的，坚定的；公司，商号
words.s: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
words.sz: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。
words.d: A firm thing is solid but not too hard.

words.s: She banged the table with her fist.
words.sz: 她用拳頭拍了桌子。
words.d: A fist is a hand with fingers bent in toward the palm.

words.s: It's better to teach someone how to fish than to give someone a fish.
words.sz: 授之以鱼，不如授之以渔。

t: n. 渔业；捕鱼（术）；试探；装配
words.s: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
words.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

t: 适合，配合，适应；安装，装配；适合的，恰当的；健康的，强健的
words.s: There were no hats in that store that fit me.
words.sz: 那個店裡沒有合我尺寸的帽子。

words.s: The school is located within five minutes' walk of the station.
words.sz: 學校坐落於距離車站步行五分鐘的地方。

words.s: Our employees are working around the clock to fix the damage caused by the ice storm.
words.sz: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。
words.d: To fix something is to make it work.

words.s: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
words.sz: 我很高興他們修復了暖氣系統，但現在太熱了。

words.s: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.
words.sz: 美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。
words.d: A flag is a piece of colored cloth that represents something.

words.s: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
words.sz: 硫磺燃燒著藍色的火焰。
words.d: A flame is part of a fire.

words.s: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
words.sz: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。

t: 平的；单调的；不景气的；干脆的；平坦的；扁平的；浅的
（尤指贴着另一表面）平直地；断然地；水平地；直接地，完全地
使变平；[音乐]使（音调）下降，尤指降半音
逐渐变平；[音乐]以降调唱（或奏）
words.s: My bicycle has a flat tire.
words.sz: 我的腳踏車輪胎沒氣了。
words.d: Flat describes something that is level and smooth with no curved parts.

t: 柔韧的；易弯曲的；可变通的
words.s: The tree branch was so flexible it could be bent into a circle and not break.
words.d: If something is flexible, then it can bend easily without breaking.

words.s: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
words.sz: CharlesLindbergh於1927年成功完成了第一次獨自飛越大西洋。

t: 彩车，花车；漂流物；浮舟；浮萍
words.s: Oil will float on water.
words.sz: 油漂浮在水上。
words.d: To float is to move on top of water without sinking.

words.s: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
words.sz: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。
words.d: A flood is an event in which water covers an area that is usually dry.

t: 地板，地面；楼层；基底；议员席
铺地板；打倒，击倒；（被困难）难倒
words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

t: 面粉； 粉， 粉状物质
words.s: Mix the flour with two eggs.
words.sz: 把麵粉和兩顆雞蛋混合。
words.d: Flour is a powder made from plants that is used to make foods like bread.

t: 流动，涌流；川流不息；飘扬
words.s: The water flowed over the rocks and into the lake.
words.d: To flow is to move easily and continuously in one direction.

t: 成熟，发育；开花；繁荣；旺盛
words.s: The bathtub was filled with hot water and flower petals.
words.sz: 浴缸裡滿是熱水和花瓣。
words.d: A flower is the colored part of a plant.

words.s: I was vaccinated against the flu.
words.sz: 我接种了流感疫苗。

words.s: He is afraid to fly in an airplane.
words.sz: 他怕坐飞机。

words.s: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
words.sz: 不像狗,這隻鶴從來沒有夢想過飛翔。

words.s: I can't focus on two things at the same time.
words.sz: 我不能同時注意两件事。
words.d: To focus on something is to think about it and pay attention to it.

words.s: I'm folding my dress.
words.sz: 我在叠我的连衣裙。

t: 跟随，接着；领会；沿着...前进，遵循
words.s: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
words.sz: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

words.s: The girl was always following her mother.
words.sz: 那女孩不管到哪兒都跟著母親。

words.s: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
words.sz: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。
words.d: Food is things people and animals eat.

words.s: "How long does it take to get to Vienna on foot?" he inquired.
words.sz: “步行到Vienon需要多少时间？”他问。

words.s: A football team consists of eleven players.
words.sz: 一个足球队由十一个球员组成。
words.d: Football is a sport with eleven members and an oval-shaped ball.

t: 为，为了；因为；给；对于；至于；适合于
words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.s: I will never force you to marry him.
words.sz: 我永遠不會逼你跟他結婚。
words.d: Force is a person’s strength or power.

t: 外国的；外交的；异质的；不相关的
words.s: You seem to be prejudiced against ideas that come from foreign countries.
words.sz: 你似乎對來自國外的想法有偏見。
words.d: Something foreign is something we are not used to.

words.s: She slowly disappeared into the foggy forest.
words.sz: 她緩緩消失在霧氣瀰漫的森林中。

words.s: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
words.sz: 要都解释的话，需要一辈子的时间。
words.d: We use forever in place of “for all future time” or “for a very long time.”

words.s: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.
words.sz: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。

words.s: Tom is never going to forgive me, is he?
words.sz: 汤姆永远也不会原谅我了，是吗？
words.d: To forgive someone is to stop being angry with them.

words.s: We've come to a fork in the road.
words.sz: 我們來到了岔路口。

t: 形状，形式；表格；组成，构成
words.s: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
words.sz: 線條藝術強調形式和輪廓，而不是顏色、陰影和紋理。
words.d: To form is to make or to shape something.

words.s: There's no need for you to prepare a formal speech.
words.sz: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
words.d: A formal thing is official or serious.

words.s: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
words.sz: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
words.d: Former describes something that used to be but is not anymore.

words.s: Fortunately, no passengers were injured.
words.sz: 万幸，没乘客受伤。

words.s: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
words.sz: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。
words.d: Fortune means the things that happen but are not controlled by a person.

words.s: She looks young. However, she's actually over forty.
words.sz: 她看起来是年轻的，但实际上她四十多岁了。

words.s: We are all looking forward to seeing you and your family.
words.sz: 我们都期待看到你和你的家人。
words.d: If you move forward, you move in the direction in front of you.

words.s: I thought we had found the perfect hiding place, but the police found us.
words.sz: 我以为我们发现了绝妙的藏身之处，但警察找到了我们。
words.d: To found a company or organization means to start it.

words.s: Four hundred million people speak English as their first language.
words.sz: 四億人以英語作為他們的第一語言。

words.s: I lost my father to a subarachnoid haemorrhage when I was fourteen.
words.sz: 我十四岁的时候，父亲死于蛛网膜下出血。

t: 第四的，第四个的；四分之一的
第四，月的第四日；四分之一
words.s: My office is on the fourth floor of that gray six-story building.
words.sz: 我的办公室在那幢灰色的六层楼的四楼。

t: 给…镶框； 陷害， 诬告； 制定； 表达
words.s: I have to get a frame for my friend’s picture.
words.d: A frame is a border for a picture or mirror.

t: 免费的；自由的，不受约束的；[化学] 游离的
words.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
words.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。

words.s: Freedom is the center of American democracy.
words.sz: 美國民主的中心思想是自由。

words.s: It may freeze next week.
words.sz: 下周可能会结冰。

t: 屡次； 次数， 频率
words.s: The frequency of rainstorms is very high, especially during the spring.
words.d: The frequency of something is the number of times that it happens.

t: adv. 频繁地，经常地；时常，屡次
words.s: How frequently do you check your mail?
words.sz: 你多久看一次郵箱？
words.d: When something happens frequently, it happens often.

t: 新鲜的；清新的；淡水的；无经验的
words.s: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for your health.
words.sz: 新鮮水果和蔬菜有益健康。

words.s: My car broke down this morning and won't be repaired until Friday.
words.sz: 我的车今天早上坏了，星期五才能修好。

words.s: Get yourself something to eat from the fridge.
words.sz: 你去冰箱拿點東西吃吧。

words.s: "Where have you been?" "I have been to the station to see a friend off."
words.sz: “你去哪儿了？”“我去了火车站送我的一个朋友。”
words.d: A friend is someone a person knows and likes spending time with.

t: 友好的；亲切的；支持的；融洽的，和睦的
words.s: I'm going to stop trying to be friendly with you.
words.sz: 我不跟你要好了。

words.s: I hope that this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
words.sz: 希望這是美好友誼的開始。
words.d: Friendship is the relationship between people who are friends.

words.s: Scary movies will frighten the children.
words.sz: 恐怖片會嚇到小孩。

words.s: She was only frightened, not injured.
words.sz: 她只是被嚇到了並沒有受傷。

words.s: This movie is frightening to the children.
words.sz: 這部電影對小孩來說很可怕。

words.s: Eat a live frog every morning, and nothing worse will happen to you the rest of the day.
words.sz: 每天早上吃一隻活青蛙,那麼你一天中其他的時間就不會發生什麼更糟糕的事了。

words.s: After he had graduated from the university, he taught English for two years.
words.sz: 從他大學畢業以後,他教了兩年的英語。
words.d: From shows a starting place or position.

words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

t: 结冰（freeze的过去分词）；凝固；变得刻板
words.s: We were nearly frozen to death.
words.sz: 我们几乎被冻死了。

words.s: I found a good place to buy fruit a couple of days ago.
words.sz: 前几天我发现了一个买水果的好地方。
words.d: Fruit is a type of healthy food that grows on trees and plants.

words.s: Tom doesn't even know how to fry an egg.
words.sz: 汤姆甚至连怎么煎鸡蛋都不知道。

words.s: The fuel tank in the car is full.
words.sz: 汽車油箱是滿的。
words.d: Fuel is something that creates heat or energy.

t: 完全的，完整的；满的，充满的；丰富的；完美的；丰满的；详尽的
words.s: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
words.sz: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

t: adv. 充分地；完全地；彻底地
words.s: I am fully convinced of your innocence.
words.sz: 我完全相信你是清白的。

t: 乐趣；玩笑；有趣的人或事
words.s: It's fun to learn slang words in foreign languages.
words.sz: 学习外语里的俚语很有趣。
words.d: When something is fun, it is enjoyable.

t: 功能，作用；职务，职责；正式的典礼，宴会
words.s: The function of a flashlight is to help you see in the dark.
words.d: The function of something is what it does.

t: 资金，基金；储备，蕴藏；为...提供资金，资助
words.s: We all put money into our club’s fund.
words.d: A fund is an amount of money that people have.

t: 基础的，基本的；根本的，主要的，十分重大的，基本原则
words.s: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
words.sz: 無須多言，基本人權應當被尊重。
words.d: If something is fundamental, it is a basic part of something.

t: n. 提供资金；用发行长期债券的方法来收回短期债券
v. 提供资金；积存（fund的ing形式）
有趣的，好笑的，滑稽的；（口）稀奇的，古怪的，奇异的；有病的，不舒服的；狡猾的，欺骗（性）的，可疑的，不光明
滑稽人物；笑话，有趣的故事；滑稽连环漫画栏；（英）（比赛用）单人双桨小艇
words.s: He told us such a funny story that we all laughed.
words.sz: 他给我们讲了一个有趣的故事，我们都笑了起来。

words.s: Fur coats are on sale.
words.sz: 毛皮大衣在打折。

words.s: A few years ago, our room had little furniture in it.
words.sz: 幾年前，我們的房間裡沒有什麼家具。
words.d: Furniture means the things used in a house such as tables and chairs.

words.s: The horse stopped and refused to go any further.
words.sz: 馬停了下來，而且拒絕移動。
words.d: Further means at or from a greater distance or time.

words.s: She’s clever, and furthermore, she is not afraid of work.
words.d: Furthermore means more information will be added.

words.s: I really look forward to your visit in the near future.
words.sz: 我很期待在不久的將來您的光臨。

words.s: They tried very hard to gain an advantage over one another.
words.sz: 他們很努力地超過對方獲得優勢。
words.d: To gain is to gradually get more and more of a quality, feeling, etc.

words.s: The art gallery displayed beautiful paintings.
words.d: A gallery is a large space where people can see works of art.

words.s: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.
words.sz: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。
words.d: A game is an activity where people compete against each other.

words.s: The gang was planning a robbery.
words.sz: 這夥人計劃搶劫。

words.s: There is a small gap between the blocks of wood.
words.d: A gap is a space between two things.

t: 车库；汽车修理厂；飞机库
把……送入车库；把（汽车）开进车库
words.s: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
words.sz: 汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎么办。
words.d: A garage is the part of a house where people put their cars.

words.s: Tom said he thought that he'd be able to help Mary weed the garden today.
words.sz: 汤姆说他以为他今天能够帮玛丽的花园除草
words.d: A garden is an area where people grow plants.

words.s: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
words.sz: 這場爆炸有可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。

words.s: The gate is so narrow that the car can't pass through it.
words.sz: 门太窄了，这辆车通不过。
words.d: A gate is a type of door. Gates are usually made of metal or wood.

words.s: I gather that they'll agree with us.
words.sz: 我猜想他們會同意我們的。
words.d: To gather is to form a group or bring together.

t: 一般的，普遍的；总的，大体的；将军
words.s: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
words.sz: 一般來說，消费者喜歡數量勝於質量。

t: 一般地， 通常地； 普遍地
words.s: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
words.sz: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。
words.d: We use generally in place of “in most cases” or “to most people.”

words.s: An electric current can generate magnetism.
words.sz: 電流可以產生磁性。
words.d: To generate something means to cause it to develop or begin.

t: 产生，发生；一代人，同时代人；同一时期的产品
words.s: My parents' generation went through the war.
words.sz: 我父母那一代经历过战争。
words.d: A generation is a group of people who live at the same time.

t: 丰富的，大量的；慷慨的，大方的
words.s: I don't think that Tom was as generous as he should've been.
words.sz: 我認為湯姆不夠大方。
words.d: A generous person likes to give things to people.

words.s: She is considered a master in the comedy genre.
words.d: A genre is a type of literature, art, or music characterized by its style.

words.s: She gave the door a gentle push.
words.sz: 她輕輕地推了門。
words.d: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm.

words.s: His dress is that of a gentleman, but his speech and behavior are those of a clown.
words.sz: 他衣着像个绅士，言行举止却像个小丑。
words.d: A gentleman is a nice man.

words.s: He likes geography and history.
words.sz: 他喜欢地理和历史。
words.d: Geography is the study of the Earth, its land, weather, etc.

words.s: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
words.sz: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

words.s: You look like you've just seen a ghost.
words.sz: 你看起來就像見鬼了一樣。

words.s: The giant truck got in my way.
words.d: Giant means very big.

words.s: Tom asked Mary to buy a gift for John.
words.sz: 汤姆叫玛丽买一份礼物给约翰。
words.d: A gift is something you give someone.

t: 女孩；姑娘，未婚女子；女职员，女演员；（男人的）女朋友
words.s: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
words.sz: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

words.s: You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.
words.sz: 如果你女朋友发现真相的话，你会有麻烦的。

words.s: Rather than cutting down on cigarettes, why don't you just give them up?
words.sz: 比起少抽菸，你何不直接把菸戒了？

t: 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的；灿烂美丽的
(Glad)人名；(塞、瑞典)格拉德；(英)格莱德；(法、挪)格拉
words.s: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
words.sz: 我很高興他們修復了暖氣系統，但現在太熱了。
words.d: If you are glad, you are happy.

words.s: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.
words.sz: 万一发生火灾，打碎玻璃并按下红色按钮。
words.d: Glass is a transparent, breakable material.

words.s: Global warming worries scientists.
words.sz: 全球變暖讓科學家擔心。
words.d: If something is global, it happens all around the world.

words.s: When it gets cold, I always put on a pair of gloves.
words.d: A glove is a piece of clothing that covers your fingers and hand.

words.s: If you want to go, then go. If you don't want to, then it's no big deal.
words.sz: 如果你想去，就去好了。如果你不想去，那也没什么大不了的。

words.s: He never gave up hope that he would reach that goal.
words.sz: 他從沒放棄達成那個目標的希望。
words.d: A goal is something you work toward.

words.s: According to the Bible, God created the world in six days.
words.sz: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

words.s: In 1848, people came to California to dig for gold.
words.sz: 1848年人们来加利福尼亚淘金。

words.s: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.
words.sz: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。
words.d: Golf is a sport with clubs and a small white ball.

t: n. 好处；善行；慷慨的行为
adj. 好的；优良的；愉快的；虔诚的
words.s: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
words.sz: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

words.s: He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.
words.sz: 他甚至没说再见就离开了家。

words.s: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
words.sz: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。
words.d: Goods are anything that can be bought or sold.

t: 统治，管理；决定，支配；抑制，控制

words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

t: 抓取，攫取；赶紧做；抓住；抓，夺
words.s: Anybody wanna grab something to eat with me?

words.d: An ideal thing is the best that it can possibly be.

words.s: I used the file to identify his name.
words.d: To identify something is to find out what it is.

t: 相同性，一致性；本身，本体；身份
words.s: We know the identity of Tom's killer.
words.sz: 我們知道湯姆的殺手是誰。

t: （表条件）如果；即使；是否；（表假设）假如
words.s: If he had been a little more careful, the accident would have been avoided.
words.sz: 如果他当时再小心一点点，事故就不会发生了。

words.s: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.
words.sz: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。
words.d: To ignore something is to act like you do not see or hear it.

t: 有病的；坏的，不利的；恶意的
words.s: They called in a doctor because the child was ill.
words.sz: 他們打電話給醫生因為這個孩子生病了。

t: [法] 非法的；违法的；违反规则的
words.s: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
words.sz: 在加拿大有很多區域砍伐樹木是非法的。

words.s: We take health for granted until illness intervenes.
words.sz: 我們視健康為理所當然,直到疾病侵襲。

words.s: What image did you have in mind as you painted this picture?
words.sz: 画这幅画的时候你脑海中浮现出了什么图像？
words.d: The image of something is a picture of it.

words.s: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
words.sz: 有的科學家認為溫室效應是虛構的。

words.s: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
words.sz: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

words.s: I imagine that you are wondering when your new PC will arrive.
words.sz: 我猜您一定想知道您的新電腦什麼時候到貨。
words.d: To imagine something is to think of it in your mind.

t: 立即的，即时的；直接的，最接近的
words.s: An immediate response came from the pizza place.
words.d: If something is immediate, it happens quickly.

t: 立即， 马上； 直接地， 紧接地
words.s: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
words.sz: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

words.s: My parents were immigrants. They came from Poland.
words.d: An immigrant is a person who moves to a different country.

t: 挤入，压紧；撞击；对…产生影响
words.s: My grandmother had a great impact on my life.
words.d: An impact is the effect someone or something has.

words.s: Tom told me he thought Mary would be impatient.
words.sz: 湯姆告訴我，他以為瑪莉會有耐心。
words.d: To be impatient means to get angry or anxious when something takes too much time.

words.s: I didn't mean to imply otherwise.
words.sz: 我沒想要暗示其他事。
words.d: To imply something is to suggest it without saying it.

words.s: We import tea from India.
words.sz: 我們從印度進口茶葉。
words.d: To import means to bring in a product from another country.

words.s: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.
words.sz: 这被认为是一件大事。
words.d: Importance is the quality or state of being important, valuable, or significant.

t: 重要的，重大的；有权利的
words.s: Many parents think it's important for their children to eat before 8:00 p.m.
words.sz: 許多父母認為讓自己的子女在下午八點前吃完飯是很重要的。

words.s: He imposes on his wife every morning by expecting her to make his breakfast.
words.d: To impose means to interrupt or force your ideas on other people.

t: 不可能的；不可能存在的；难以忍受的；不真实的
words.s: It's impossible to do the sights of Tokyo in a day or two.
words.sz: 一两天是没办法逛完东京的。

words.s: He was able to impress the girls with his new dance.
words.d: To impress someone means to make that person proud or amazed.

t: 被打动的， 被感动的
words.s: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
words.sz: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

words.s: You never get a second chance to make a first impression.
words.sz: 你永遠沒有第二次機會去打造第一印象。
words.d: An impression is the way of thinking about someone or something.

t: 给人深刻印象的，感人的
words.s: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
words.sz: 今天你们俩很让人印象深刻。我为你们感到骄傲。

words.s: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
words.sz: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。
words.d: To improve something means to make it better.

words.s: Your essay still needs some improvement.
words.sz: 你的论文还需要改进。

t: 按照（表示方式）；从事于；在…之内
进入；当选；（服装等）时髦；在屋里
words.s: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
words.sz: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。

words.s: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.
words.sz: 得寸进尺。

words.s: The incident made everyone feel more embarrassed.
words.sz: 這件事弄得大家都比較尷尬。
words.d: An incident is an event that is usually not pleasant.

words.s: The price does not include the box.
words.sz: 這個價格不包含這個箱子。
words.d: To include something means to have it as part of a group.

words.s: His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.
words.sz: 他的收入很高，所以每年都能出國旅行。
words.d: An income is the money you earned from work.

words.s: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
words.sz: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。
words.d: To increase is to make something larger.

t: 难以置信的，惊人的，不可思议的
words.s: I have an incredible story to tell you about my vacation.
words.d: An incredible thing is so amazing that it is hard to believe.

words.s: I felt incredibly nervous.
words.sz: 我感到万分焦虑。

words.s: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
words.sz: 患難見真情。

t: 独立的，自主的；无党派的；私营的
words.s: He is independent of his parents.
words.sz: 他獨立於他的父母。
words.d: If something is independent, it is not controlled by something else.

words.s: Smiles do not always indicate pleasure.
words.sz: 微笑並不一定表示高興。
words.d: When we indicate something, we show or point out our thoughts or plans.

t: adj. 间接的；迂回的；非直截了当的
words.s: He chose to take the most indirect route to the coast.
words.d: If something is indirect, then it is not the easiest or straightest way.

t: 个人的，单独的；独特的，有个性的
words.s: Each individual is responsible for themselves.
words.d: An individual is a single member of a group.

words.s: When I was a child, I spent most of my time indoors reading.
words.sz: 当我是个孩子的时候，我会把大部分时间都用于室内阅读。

words.s: Many people work in industrial towns.
words.sz: 许多人在工业城市工作。

words.s: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
words.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
words.d: Industry is a kind of business that produces services or things for sale.

t: n. 感染；传染；影响；传染病

words.s: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
words.sz: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。
words.d: To influence someone or something is to have an effect on them.

t: 通知，告诉，报告；告发，告密
words.s: We should inform them about that.
words.sz: 我们应该把那件事情告知他们。
words.d: To inform someone is to tell them about something.

words.s: They had an informal meeting to talk about their experiences.
words.d: An informal thing is casual and relaxed, not official.

words.s: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
words.sz: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。

words.s: The main ingredients in cake are eggs, sugar, and flour.
words.d: An ingredient is something that is part of a food dish.

t: 最初的，开始的，开头的；词首的
words.s: The initial step when writing a paper is to find a good topic.
words.d: Initial shows that something is first.

words.s: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
words.sz: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。
words.d: To injure someone means to damage a part of their body.

words.s: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.
words.sz: 他的妻子在醫院裡因為她在一場車禍中受傷了。

words.s: Not all of the passengers escaped injury.
words.sz: 並非所有的乘客都免於受傷。

words.s: Tom and Mary admired the scenery as they held hands.
words.sz: 汤姆和玛丽手牵着手，一起欣赏风景。

words.s: He hid in the bushes so that they would not see him.
words.sz: 他藏身在灌木中以免他們發現。

words.s: He is included among my friends.
words.sz: 他是我的朋友之一。
